### `Rng`

```salam
struct Rng
```

A deterministic random number generator; one seed always gives the same sequence.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `s` | `u64 = 0` | The internal state. |

tensor-Random.salam

```salam
import tensor

func rounded(t &: tensor.Tensor): str:
    mut text := ""
    repeat t.numel() in i:
        if i > 0:
            text += " "
        end
        text += "" + ((t.at(i) * 100.0 + 10000.5) as int - 10000)
    end
    ret text
end

func main:
    mut rng := tensor.NewRng(42)
    println rng.next_bits() > 0, rng.next_float() < 1.0, rng.next_normal() < 10.0
    println tensor.DeriveSeed(42, 1) != tensor.DeriveSeed(42, 2)
    mut v := tensor.Zeros1(5)
    tensor.FillUniform(v, 0.0, 1.0, rng)
    println tensor.MinAll(v) >= 0.0, tensor.MaxAll(v) < 1.0
    tensor.FillNormal(v, 0.0, 1.0, rng)
    tensor.FillBernoulli(v, 0.5, rng)
    println tensor.SumAll(v) <= 5.0
    mut t1 := tensor.RandUniform(tensor.Shape1(3), -1.0, 1.0, 7)
    mut t2 := tensor.RandUniform(tensor.Shape1(3), -1.0, 1.0, 7)
    println tensor.Equal(t1, t2), rounded(t1)
    mut n := tensor.RandNormal(tensor.Shape1(2), 7)
    println n.numel()

    tensor.SetThreads(2)
    println tensor.Threads()

    println tensor.ConvOutSize(5, 3, 1, 1), tensor.ConvOutSize(5, 3, 2, 0)
    mut image := tensor.Reshape(tensor.Arange(16), tensor.Shape4(1, 1, 4, 4))
    mut kernel := tensor.Ones(tensor.Shape4(1, 1, 2, 2))
    mut bias := tensor.Zeros1(1)
    mut conv := tensor.Conv2DForward(image, kernel, bias, 2, 2, 0, 0)
    println tensor.ShapeString(conv), rounded(conv)
    mut argmax := tensor.Empty()
    mut pooled := tensor.MaxPool2DForward(image, 2, 2, 2, 2, argmax)
    println rounded(pooled), rounded(argmax)
    println rounded(tensor.AvgPool2DForward(image, 2, 2, 2, 2))
    mut cols := tensor.Im2Col(image, 0, 2, 2, 2, 2, 0, 0)
    println tensor.ShapeString(cols)
    mut grad := tensor.Zeros4(1, 1, 4, 4)
    println tensor.Col2ImAcc(cols, grad, 0, 2, 2, 2, 2, 0, 0), tensor.Equal(grad, image)

    mut m := tensor.Reshape(tensor.Arange(6), tensor.Shape2(2, 3))
    mut mt := tensor.TransposeRaw(m.data.ref(0), 2, 3)
    println tensor.ShapeString(mt), rounded(mt)
    mut product := tensor.Zeros2(2, 2)
    tensor.GemmAcc(m.data.ref(0), mt.data.ref(0), product.data.ref(0), 2, 3, 2)
    println rounded(product)
end
```

```salam
import tensor

func show(name: str, t &: tensor.Tensor):
    println name, tensor.ToString(t)
end

func show_rounded(name: str, t &: tensor.Tensor):
    mut text := ""
    repeat t.numel() in i:
        rounded := (t.at(i) * 1000.0 + 0.5) as int
        text += " " + rounded
    end
    println name + " x1000:" + text
end

func main:
    mut a := tensor.Arange(4)
    mut b := tensor.Full(tensor.Shape1(4), 2.0)
    mut sum := a + b
    show("+", sum)
    mut mixed := a * b - b / b
    show("*-/", mixed)
    mut added := tensor.Add(a, b)
    mut subtracted := tensor.Sub(a, b)
    mut multiplied := tensor.Mul(a, b)
    mut divided := tensor.Div(a, b)
    show("Add", added)
    show("Sub", subtracted)
    show("Mul", multiplied)
    show("Div", divided)
    mut out := tensor.Zeros1(4)
    println tensor.AddInto(a, b, out), tensor.SubInto(a, b, out), tensor.MulInto(a, b, out), tensor.DivInto(a, b, out)
    show("DivInto", out)
    show("+1", tensor.AddScalar(a, 1.0))
    show("-1", tensor.SubScalar(a, 1.0))
    show("x3", tensor.Scale(a, 3.0))
    show("/2", tensor.DivScalar(a, 2.0))
    show("Neg", tensor.Neg(a))

    mut d := tensor.Clone(a)
    tensor.AddInPlace(d, b)
    tensor.SubInPlace(d, a)
    tensor.MulInPlace(d, b)
    tensor.ScaleInPlace(d, 0.5)
    tensor.AddScalarInPlace(d, 1.0)
    tensor.AddScaled(d, a, 2.0)
    show("in place", d)

    show_rounded("Exp", tensor.Clip(tensor.Exp(a), 0.0, 10.0))
    show_rounded("Log", tensor.Log(b))
    show("Tanh", tensor.Tanh(tensor.Zeros1(2)))
    show_rounded("Sigmoid", tensor.Sigmoid(tensor.Zeros1(2)))
    show("Relu", tensor.Relu(tensor.Neg(a)))
    show_rounded("Gelu", tensor.Gelu(tensor.Zeros1(2)))
    show_rounded("Silu", tensor.Silu(tensor.Zeros1(2)))
    show("Sqrt", tensor.Sqrt(tensor.Mul(b, b)))
    show("Abs", tensor.Abs(tensor.Neg(a)))
    show("Square", tensor.Square(a))
    show("PowScalar", tensor.PowScalar(a, 3.0))

    println tensor.SumAll(a), tensor.MeanAll(a), tensor.MaxAll(a), tensor.MinAll(a), tensor.ArgMaxAll(a)
    mut m := tensor.Reshape(tensor.Arange(6), tensor.Shape2(2, 3))
    show("SumAxis", tensor.SumAxis(m, 0, false))
    show("MeanAxis", tensor.MeanAxis(m, 1, true))
    show("MaxAxis", tensor.MaxAxis(m, 1, false))
    show("ArgMaxAxis", tensor.ArgMaxAxis(m, 1, false))
    show("Cumsum", tensor.Cumsum(m, 1))
    println tensor.SumAll(tensor.Softmax(m)) > 1.99, tensor.MaxAll(tensor.LogSoftmax(a)) < 0.0

    mut t := tensor.Transpose2D(m)
    show("Transpose2D", t)
    show("MatMul", tensor.MatMul(m, t))
    show("TransposeMul", tensor.TransposeMul(m, m))
    show("MulTranspose", tensor.MulTranspose(m, m))
    mut product := tensor.Zeros2(2, 2)
    println tensor.MatMulInto(m, t, product), tensor.MatMulAcc(m, t, product)
    show("MatMulAcc", product)
    show("MatVec", tensor.MatVec(m, tensor.Ones(tensor.Shape1(3))))
    mut batch := tensor.Stack2(m, m)
    mut batch_t := tensor.Stack2(t, t)
    println tensor.ShapeString(tensor.BatchMatMul(batch, batch_t)), tensor.Dot(a, b)
    println tensor.MaxAbsDiff(a, added), tensor.AllClose(added, sum, 0.001)
end
```

### `BroadcastShape`

```salam
func BroadcastShape(a &: Tensor, b &: Tensor, out &: Vector<int>): bool
```

The shape two tensors broadcast to; false when they do not fit together.

tensor-Index.salam

```salam
import tensor

func show(name: str, t &: tensor.Tensor):
    println name, tensor.ToString(t)
end

func main:
    mut a := tensor.Arange(4)
    mut b := tensor.Full(tensor.Shape1(4), 1.5)
    show("Greater", tensor.Greater(a, b))
    show("GreaterEqual", tensor.GreaterEqual(a, tensor.Clone(a)))
    show("Less", tensor.Less(a, b))
    show("LessEqual", tensor.LessEqual(a, b))
    show("EqualMask", tensor.EqualMask(a, a))
    show("NotEqualMask", tensor.NotEqualMask(a, b))
    show("GreaterScalar", tensor.GreaterScalar(a, 1.0))
    show("LessScalar", tensor.LessScalar(a, 1.0))
    show("EqualScalar", tensor.EqualScalar(a, 2.0))
    mut mask := tensor.Greater(a, b)
    show("Where", tensor.Where(mask, a, tensor.Neg(a)))
    show("MaskedFill", tensor.MaskedFill(a, mask, -1.0))

    mut m := tensor.Reshape(tensor.Arange(6), tensor.Shape2(3, 2))
    mut indices := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    indices.push(2)
    indices.push(0)
    show("IndexSelect", tensor.IndexSelect(m, 0, indices))
    show("TakeRows", tensor.TakeRows(m, indices))
    mut places := tensor.Zeros2(3, 1)
    places.set_at(0, 1.0)
    show("Gather", tensor.Gather(m, 1, places))
    mut target := tensor.Zeros2(3, 2)
    println tensor.ScatterAddRows(target, indices, tensor.Ones(tensor.Shape2(2, 2)))
    show("ScatterAddRows", target)
    show("OneHot", tensor.OneHot(indices, 3))

    mut scores := tensor.Reshape(tensor.Arange(5), tensor.Shape1(5))
    mut top_places := tensor.Empty()
    show("TopK", tensor.TopK(scores, 2, true, top_places))
    show("TopK places", top_places)
    mut square := tensor.Ones(tensor.Shape2(3, 3))
    show("Tril", tensor.Tril(square, 0))
    show("Triu", tensor.Triu(square, 1))
    mut broadcast := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    println tensor.BroadcastShape(m, tensor.Ones(tensor.Shape1(2)), broadcast), broadcast.len(), broadcast.get(0)
    show("Pad2D", tensor.Pad2D(tensor.Ones(tensor.Shape4(1, 1, 1, 1)), 1, 0, 0, 1))
end
```

Output:

```text
Greater tensor(4)[0 0 1 1]
GreaterEqual tensor(4)[1 1 1 1]
Less tensor(4)[1 1 0 0]
LessEqual tensor(4)[1 1 0 0]
EqualMask tensor(4)[1 1 1 1]
NotEqualMask tensor(4)[1 1 1 1]
GreaterScalar tensor(4)[0 0 1 1]
LessScalar tensor(4)[1 0 0 0]
EqualScalar tensor(4)[0 0 1 0]
Where tensor(4)[0 -1 2 3]
MaskedFill tensor(4)[0 1 -1 -1]
IndexSelect tensor(2x2)[4 5 0 1]
TakeRows tensor(2x2)[4 5 0 1]
Gather tensor(3x1)[1 2 4]
true
ScatterAddRows tensor(3x2)[1 1 0 0 1 1]
OneHot tensor(2x3)[0 0 1 1 0 0]
TopK tensor(2)[4 3]
TopK places tensor(2)[4 3]
Tril tensor(3x3)[1 0 0 1 1 0 1 1 1]
Triu tensor(3x3)[0 1 1 0 0 1 0 0 0]
true 2 3
Pad2D tensor(1x1x2x2)[0 0 1 0]
```

# autograd

https://salamlang.github.io/Salam/std/autograd/

Reverse mode automatic differentiation for training models.

Training a model means lowering the loss with gradients. This package records every computation on a `Tape`, and `Backward` works out the gradient of the loss for every input. The functions return a node index rather than a tensor; read the value with `Value` and the gradient with `Grad`.

Call `reset` on the tape at every training step. The ready made layers are in nn and the optimisers in optim.

## Types

### `Node`

```salam
struct Node
```

One node on the tape.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `op` | `int = 0` | The operation. |
| `a` | `int = -1` | The first input. |
| `b` | `int = -1` | The second input. |
| `out` | `int = -1` | The output. |
| `aux` | `int = -1` | The auxiliary data. |
| `s0` | `int = 0` | The first integer parameter. |
| `s1` | `int = 0` | The second integer parameter. |
| `f0` | `f64 = 0` | The float parameter. |

autograd-Basics.salam

```salam
import autograd
import tensor

func rounded(t: tensor.Tensor): str:
    mut text := ""
    repeat t.numel() in i:
        if i > 0:
            text += " "
        end
        text += "" + ((t.at(i) * 100.0 + 10000.5) as int - 10000)
    end
    ret text
end

func main:
    mut tape := autograd.NewTape(1)
    mut x_value := tensor.Arange(3)
    mut three_value := tensor.Full(tensor.Shape1(3), 3.0)
    x := autograd.Watch(tape, x_value)
    three := autograd.Constant(tape, three_value)
    squared := autograd.Square(tape, x)
    linear := autograd.Mul(tape, three, x)
    loss := autograd.Sum(tape, autograd.Add(tape, squared, linear))
    autograd.Backward(tape, loss)
    println rounded(autograd.Value(tape, loss)), rounded(autograd.Grad(tape, x)), tape.len()

    tape.reset()
    a := autograd.Input(tape, x_value)
    one := autograd.AddScalar(tape, a, 1.0)
    every := [
        autograd.Sub(tape, a, one), autograd.Div(tape, a, one), autograd.Neg(tape, a), autograd.Scale(tape, a, 2.0),
        autograd.Exp(tape, a), autograd.Log(tape, one), autograd.Tanh(tape, a), autograd.Sigmoid(tape, a),
        autograd.Relu(tape, a), autograd.Gelu(tape, a), autograd.Silu(tape, a), autograd.Sqrt(tape, one),
        autograd.PowScalar(tape, a, 3.0), autograd.Softmax(tape, a), autograd.LogSoftmax(tape, a), autograd.Mean(tape, a)
    ]
    each node in every:
        println rounded(autograd.Value(tape, node))
    end

    tape.reset()
    mut m_value := tensor.Reshape(tensor.Arange(6), tensor.Shape2(2, 3))
    mut m_grad := tensor.Zeros2(2, 3)
    m := autograd.Param(tape, m_value, m_grad)
    t := autograd.Transpose2D(tape, m)
    product := autograd.MatMul(tape, m, t)
    println rounded(autograd.Value(tape, product))
    println rounded(autograd.Value(tape, autograd.SumAxis(tape, m, 0, false)))
    println rounded(autograd.Value(tape, autograd.MeanAxis(tape, m, 1, false)))
    mut shape := tensor.Shape1(6)
    println tensor.ShapeString(autograd.Value(tape, autograd.Reshape(tape, m, shape)))
    autograd.Backward(tape, autograd.Sum(tape, product))
    println rounded(m_grad)
    tape.free()
end
```

Output:

```text
1400 300 500 700 6
-100 -100 -100
0 50 67
0 -100 -200
0 200 400
100 272 739
0 69 110
0 76 96
50 73 88
0 100 200
0 84 195
0 73 176
100 141 173
0 100 800
9 24 67
-241 -141 -41
100
500 1400 1400 5000
300 500 700
100 400
6
600 1000 1400 600 1000 1400
```

### `Tape`

```salam
struct Tape
```

The tape: it records every computation so backpropagation can work out the gradients. Each node is known by an integer index.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vals` | `Vector` | The values of the nodes. |
| `grads` | `Vector` | The gradients of the nodes. |
| `owns_val` | `Vector` | The tape owns the value. |
| `owns_grad` | `Vector` | The tape owns the gradient. |
| `needs` | `Vector` | The node needs a gradient. |
| `nodes` | `Vector` | The nodes. |
| `training` | `bool = true` | Training mode; dropout only acts in training. |
| `rng` | `tensor.Rng` | The random generator of the tape. |

The example for this item is shown with the ones above: autograd-Basics.salam

#### `len`

```salam
func len(): int
```

The number of nodes.

The example for this item is shown with the ones above: autograd-Basics.salam

#### `reset`

```salam
func reset()
```

Empties the tape for the next step.

The example for this item is shown with the ones above: autograd-Basics.salam

#### `free`

```salam
func free()
```

Frees the tape.

The example for this item is shown with the ones above: autograd-Basics.salam

## Functions

### `MSELoss`

```salam
func MSELoss(tp &: Tape, pred: int, target: int): int
```

The mean squared error loss; for regression.

autograd-Layers.salam

```salam
import autograd
import tensor

func rounded(t: tensor.Tensor): str:
    mut text := ""
    repeat t.numel() in i:
        if i > 0:
            text += " "
        end
        text += "" + ((t.at(i) * 100.0 + 10000.5) as int - 10000)
    end
    ret text
end

func cube(t: tensor.Tensor): f64:
    mut total := 0.0
    repeat t.numel() in i:
        total += t.at(i) * t.at(i) * t.at(i)
    end
    ret total
end

func main:
    mut tape := autograd.NewTape(7)
    mut image := tensor.Reshape(tensor.Arange(16), tensor.Shape4(1, 1, 4, 4))
    mut kernel := tensor.Ones(tensor.Shape4(2, 1, 2, 2))
    mut bias := tensor.Zeros1(2)
    img := autograd.Input(tape, image)
    weight := autograd.Constant(tape, kernel)
    b := autograd.Constant(tape, bias)
    conv := autograd.Conv2D(tape, img, weight, b, 2, 2, 0, 0)
    println tensor.ShapeString(autograd.Value(tape, conv))
    println rounded(autograd.Value(tape, autograd.MaxPool2D(tape, img, 2, 2, 2, 2)))
    println rounded(autograd.Value(tape, autograd.AvgPool2D(tape, img, 2, 2, 2, 2)))
    println tensor.ShapeString(autograd.Value(tape, autograd.GroupNorm(tape, conv, autograd.Constant(tape, tensor.Ones(tensor.Shape1(2))), autograd.Constant(tape, tensor.Zeros1(2)), 2, 0.00001)))
    mut running_mean := tensor.Zeros1(2)
    mut running_var := tensor.Ones(tensor.Shape1(2))
    norm := autograd.BatchNorm(tape, conv, autograd.Constant(tape, tensor.Ones(tensor.Shape1(2))), autograd.Constant(tape, tensor.Zeros1(2)), running_mean, running_var, 0.1, 0.00001)
    println tensor.ShapeString(autograd.Value(tape, norm)), rounded(running_mean)

    mut row := tensor.Reshape(tensor.Arange(8), tensor.Shape2(2, 4))
    r := autograd.Input(tape, row)
    gamma := autograd.Constant(tape, tensor.Ones(tensor.Shape1(4)))
    beta := autograd.Constant(tape, tensor.Zeros1(4))
    println rounded(autograd.Value(tape, autograd.LayerNorm(tape, r, gamma, beta, 0.00001)))
    println tensor.ShapeString(autograd.Value(tape, autograd.RMSNorm(tape, r, gamma, 0.00001)))
    println rounded(autograd.Value(tape, autograd.Narrow(tape, r, 1, 1, 2)))
    println rounded(autograd.Value(tape, autograd.SliceAxis0(tape, r, 1, 1)))
    println tensor.ShapeString(autograd.Value(tape, autograd.Concat2(tape, r, r, 0)))
    mut order := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    order.push(1)
    order.push(0)
    println tensor.ShapeString(autograd.Value(tape, autograd.Permute(tape, r, order)))
    mut three_dim := tensor.Ones(tensor.Shape3(2, 2, 3))
    s := autograd.Input(tape, three_dim)
    println tensor.ShapeString(autograd.Value(tape, autograd.BatchMatMul(tape, s, autograd.Permute(tape, s, tensor.Shape3(0, 2, 1)))))
    println tensor.ShapeString(autograd.Value(tape, autograd.RoPE(tape, r, 2, 1, 0, 10000.0)))
    println rounded(autograd.Value(tape, autograd.Dropout(tape, r, 0.0)))

    mut vocab := tensor.Reshape(tensor.Arange(6), tensor.Shape2(3, 2))
    mut indices := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    indices.push(2)
    indices.push(0)
    println rounded(autograd.Value(tape, autograd.Embedding(tape, autograd.Constant(tape, vocab), indices)))

    mut prediction := tensor.Full(tensor.Shape1(2), 1.0)
    mut target := tensor.Zeros1(2)
    println rounded(autograd.Value(tape, autograd.MSELoss(tape, autograd.Input(tape, prediction), autograd.Constant(tape, target))))
    println rounded(autograd.Value(tape, autograd.BCEWithLogits(tape, autograd.Input(tape, target), autograd.Constant(tape, target))))
    mut logits := tensor.Zeros2(2, 3)
    println rounded(autograd.Value(tape, autograd.CrossEntropyLogits(tape, autograd.Input(tape, logits), indices)))

    mut point := tensor.Arange(3)
    analytic := tensor.Mul(tensor.Square(point), tensor.Full(tensor.Shape1(3), 3.0))
    println autograd.GradCheck((t: tensor.Tensor): ret cube(t) end, point, analytic, 0.001, 0.01)
    tape.free()
end
```

# nn

https://salamlang.github.io/Salam/std/nn/

Neural network layers: linear, convolutional, recurrent, transformer, and checkpoints.

This package has ready made layers for building a model. The weights of every layer live in one `ParamStore`; make each layer with a `New...` function and a unique name, and call `forward` on the tape at every step. `Sequential` runs several layers one after the other.

Once it is trained with optim, save the model with `SaveCheckpoint` and load it again later.

## Types

### `Parameter`

```salam
struct Parameter
```

One learnable parameter.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `str = ""` | The name. |
| `value` | `tensor.Tensor` | The value. |
| `grad` | `tensor.Tensor` | The gradient. |

nn-Layers.salam

```salam
import nn
import autograd
import optim
import tensor
import os
import compress

func main:
    mut store := nn.ParamStore {}
    mut rng := tensor.NewRng(3)
    fc1 := nn.NewLinear(store, "fc1", 2, 8, rng)
    fc2 := nn.NewLinearNoBias(store, "fc2", 8, 1, rng)
    mut model := nn.Sequential {}
    model.add(fc1)
    model.add(nn.TanhLayer {})
    model.add(fc2)
    println store.count()

    mut inputs := tensor.Reshape(tensor.Arange(8), tensor.Shape2(4, 2))
    tensor.ScaleInPlace(inputs, 0.25)
    mut target := tensor.Zeros2(4, 1)
    repeat 4 in i:
        target.set_at(i, inputs.at2(i, 0) + inputs.at2(i, 1))
    end
    mut adam := optim.Adam { lr = 0.05 }
    mut tape := autograd.NewTape(1)
    mut last := 0.0
    repeat 300:
        tape.reset()
        store.zero_grad()
        output := model.forward(tape, store, autograd.Input(tape, inputs))
        loss := autograd.MSELoss(tape, output, autograd.Constant(tape, target))
        autograd.Backward(tape, loss)
        adam.step(store)
        last = autograd.Value(tape, loss).at(0)
    end
    println last < 0.01
    mut p := store.at(fc1.w)
    println p.name, tensor.ShapeString(p.value), tensor.ShapeString(p.grad)
    weight_node := nn.Bind(tape, store, fc1.w)
    println tensor.ShapeString(autograd.Value(tape, weight_node))

    path := os.TempDir() + "/salam_mlp_en.ckpt"
    println nn.SaveCheckpoint(path, store), nn.LoadCheckpoint(path, store)
    mut buffer := nn.SaveCheckpointBuf(store)
    println nn.LoadCheckpointBuf(buffer, store)
    compress.BufFree(buffer)

    mut images := tensor.Ones(tensor.Shape4(2, 1, 8, 8))
    conv := nn.NewConv2D(store, "conv", 1, 4, 3, 1, 1, rng)
    mut batch_norm := nn.NewBatchNorm(store, "bn", 4)
    group_norm := nn.NewGroupNorm(store, "gn", 4, 2)
    pool := nn.MaxPool2D { size = 2, stride = 2 }
    average := nn.AvgPool2D {}
    h := conv.forward(tape, store, autograd.Input(tape, images))
    h2 := group_norm.forward(tape, store, batch_norm.forward(tape, store, h))
    h3 := average.forward(tape, pool.forward(tape, nn.ReluLayer {}.forward(tape, store, h2)))
    flat := nn.Flatten(tape, h3)
    println tensor.ShapeString(autograd.Value(tape, h)), tensor.ShapeString(autograd.Value(tape, flat))

    row := autograd.Input(tape, tensor.Ones(tensor.Shape2(2, 4)))
    layer_norm := nn.NewLayerNorm(store, "ln", 4)
    rms_norm := nn.NewRMSNorm(store, "rms", 4)
    drop := nn.Dropout { p = 0.0 }
    gelu := nn.GeluLayer {}
    out := gelu.forward(tape, store, drop.forward(tape, rms_norm.forward(tape, store, layer_norm.forward(tape, store, row))))
    println tensor.ShapeString(autograd.Value(tape, out))

    mut weight := tensor.Zeros2(64, 64)
    nn.XavierUniform(weight, 64, 64, rng)
    println tensor.MaxAll(tensor.Abs(weight)) <= 0.22
    nn.XavierNormal(weight, 64, 64, rng)
    nn.KaimingUniform(weight, 64, rng)
    println tensor.MaxAll(tensor.Abs(weight)) <= 0.31
    nn.KaimingNormal(weight, 64, rng)
    println tensor.MaxAll(tensor.Abs(weight)) > 0.0

    tape.free()
    adam.free()
    model.free()
    batch_norm.free()
    store.free()
end
```

Output:

```text
3
true
fc1.w 2x8 2x8
2x8
true true
true
2x4x8x8 2x16
2x4
true
true
true
```

nn-Sequence.salam

```salam
import nn
import autograd
import tensor

func shape(tape &: autograd.Tape, node: int): str:
    ret tensor.ShapeString(autograd.Value(tape, node))
end

func main:
    batch := 2
    length := 3
    dim := 8
    mut store := nn.ParamStore {}
    mut rng := tensor.NewRng(11)
    mut tape := autograd.NewTape(1)

    embedding := nn.NewEmbedding(store, "embed", 10, dim, rng)
    mut tokens := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    each t in [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]:
        tokens.push(t)
    end
    h := embedding.forward(tape, store, tokens)
    mut positions := nn.SinusoidalPositions(batch, length, dim)
    h2 := autograd.Add(tape, h, autograd.Input(tape, positions))
    println shape(tape, h), tensor.ShapeString(positions)

    attention := nn.NewMultiHeadAttention(store, "attn", dim, 2, 0.0, rng)
    println shape(tape, attention.forward(tape, store, h2, batch, length))
    encoder := nn.NewTransformerEncoderLayer(store, "enc", dim, 2, 16, 0.0, rng)
    println shape(tape, encoder.forward(tape, store, h2, batch, length))
    decoder := nn.NewTransformerDecoderLayer(store, "dec", dim, 2, 16, 0.0, rng)
    println shape(tape, decoder.forward(tape, store, h2, batch, length))
    mut mask := nn.CausalMask(length)
    println tensor.ToString(tensor.LessScalar(mask, -1.0))

    mut sequence := tensor.Ones(tensor.Shape2(length * batch, 4))
    lstm := nn.NewLSTM(store, "lstm", 4, 6, rng)
    gru := nn.NewGRU(store, "gru", 4, 6, rng)
    sequence_input := autograd.Input(tape, sequence)
    states := lstm.forward(tape, store, sequence_input, length, batch)
    states2 := gru.forward(tape, store, sequence_input, length, batch)
    println shape(tape, states), shape(tape, states2), shape(tape, nn.LastStep(tape, states, length, batch))
    println store.count() > 10
    tape.free()
    store.free()
end
```

Output:

```text
6x8 6x8
6x8
6x8
6x8
tensor(3x3)[0 1 1 0 0 1 0 0 0]
6x6 6x6 2x6
true
```

# llm

https://salamlang.github.io/Salam/std/llm/

Running Llama and Qwen language models from a GGUF file.

This package runs large language models of the Llama architecture, such as Llama, Qwen and Mistral, on the processor with no outside dependency. Download the quantised model in GGUF form, read it with `LoadGgufModel` and make text with `Generate`.

For more control, `Forward` gives the logits and a `Sampler` picks the next token with temperature, top-k, top-p and a repetition penalty. The runnable example builds a small random model so it works without a download.

## Types

### `Tokenizer`

```salam
struct Tokenizer
```

The tokenizer: it turns text into indices and back.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `int` | The kind. |
| `tokens` | `Vector` | The text of the tokens. |
| `scores` | `Vector` | The scores, for SentencePiece. |
| `index` | `HashMap` | The index of each token. |
| `merges` | `HashMap` | The ranks of the BPE merges. |
| `merge_keys` | `Vector` | The merge keys. |
| `bos` | `int = -1` | The index of the beginning token; -1 means there is none. |
| `eos` | `int = -1` | The index of the end token. |
| `unk` | `int = 0` | The index of the unknown token. |
| `add_bos` | `bool = true` | Add the beginning token when encoding. |
| `byte_ids` | `Vector` | The token index of each byte. |
| `b2u` | `Vector` | The byte to character map of byte level BPE. |

llm-Generate.salam

```salam
import llm
import tensor

func main:
    mut tokenizer := llm.NewTokenizer(llm.TOK_BPE)
    each text in ["a", "b", "c", "ab"]:
        _ := tokenizer.add_token(text, 0.0)
    end
    tokenizer.add_merge("a", "b")
    tokenizer.finish()
    tokenizer.add_bos = false
    mut ids := tokenizer.encode("abcab")
    println tokenizer.size(), ids.len(), tokenizer.token_text(ids.get(0)), tokenizer.decode(ids)
    println llm.TOK_SPM, llm.ROPE_NORMAL, llm.ROPE_NEOX

    mut config := llm.Config { vocab = tokenizer.size(), dim = 8, layers = 2, heads = 2, kv_heads = 1, ff = 16, ctx = 32 }
    println config.head_dim()
    mut model := llm.RandomModel(config, 7)
    mut cache := llm.NewKVCache(config)
    println model.ok, model.layers.len(), cache.ctx

    mut logits := llm.Forward(model, cache, ids)
    println tensor.ShapeString(logits), cache.len
    mut last := llm.LogitsRow(logits, ids.len() - 1)
    greedy := llm.Greedy(logits, ids.len() - 1)
    println tensor.ShapeString(last), greedy == tensor.ArgMaxAll(last)

    mut sampler := llm.NewSampler(1)
    sampler.temperature = 0.8
    sampler.top_k = 3
    sampler.top_p = 0.9
    sampler.repeat_penalty = 1.1
    mut recent := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    next := sampler.sample(logits, ids.len() - 1, recent)
    println next >= 0 and next < tokenizer.size()

    cache.reset()
    generated := llm.GenerateIds(model, cache, ids, 4, sampler, -1)
    println generated.len()
    cache.reset()
    text := llm.Generate(model, cache, tokenizer, "ab", 3, sampler)
    println text.len() > 0
    tensor.Free(logits)
    tensor.Free(last)
    cache.free()
    model.free()
    tokenizer.free()
end
```

Output:

```text
4 3 ab abcab
0 0 1
4
true 2 32
3x4 3
1x4 true
true
4
true
```

### `Sampler`

```salam
struct Sampler
```

The sampler: it picks the next token from the logits.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `temperature` | `f64 = 1` | The temperature; lower means a more certain answer. |
| `top_k` | `int = 0` | Out of the k likeliest tokens only; zero means no limit. |
| `top_p` | `f64 = 1` | Out of the tokens whose probabilities add up to p only. |
| `repeat_penalty` | `f64 = 1` | The penalty for repeating a recent token. |
| `rng` | `tensor.Rng` | The random generator. |

The example for this item is shown with the ones above: llm-Generate.salam

#### `free`

llm-Load.salam

```salam
import llm
import gguf

func main:
    path := "models/qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct-q8_0.gguf"
    mut model := llm.Model {}
    mut tokenizer := llm.NewTokenizer(llm.TOK_BPE)
    if not llm.LoadGgufModel(path, model, tokenizer):
        println "the model was not loaded:", path
        ret
    end
    mut cache := llm.NewKVCache(model.cfg)
    mut sampler := llm.NewSampler(42)
    sampler.temperature = 0.7
    println llm.Generate(model, cache, tokenizer, "The capital of France", 20, sampler)

    mut good := false
    mut file := gguf.LoadGguf(path, good)
    config := llm.ConfigFromGguf(file)
    println config.vocab, config.dim, config.layers, config.heads, config.kv_heads, config.ff, config.ctx, config.eps, config.rope_theta, config.rope_kind
    mut model2 := llm.ModelFromGguf(file)
    mut tokenizer2 := llm.TokenizerFromGguf(file)
    println tokenizer2.bos, tokenizer2.eos, tokenizer2.unk
    model2.free()
    tokenizer2.free()
    file.free()
    cache.free()
    model.free()
    tokenizer.free()
end
```

# matrix

https://salamlang.github.io/Salam/std/matrix/

Linear algebra: matrices, systems of equations, decompositions, eigenvalues and statistics.

This package is complete linear algebra over 64 bit floats: from making a matrix and multiplying through to solving systems, decompositions, eigenvalues and singular values, and statistical tools such as principal component analysis. To solve one system, call `Solve`; for several systems with one matrix, `Decompose` once and `LUSolve` many times.

Matrices hold floats and the results carry a little rounding error; compare with `AllClose` and display with `Chop`. For neural networks see tensor.

## Types

### `PCA`

```salam
struct PCA
```

Principal component analysis.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `components` | `Matrix` | The components in the rows. |
| `variances` | `Matrix` | The variance of each component. |
| `center` | `Matrix` | The column means. |

matrix-Stats.salam

```salam
import matrix

func build(rows: int, cols: int, numbers: str): matrix.Matrix:
    mut data := Vector {} as Vector<f64>
    each number in numbers.split(" "):
        data.push(number.to_float())
    end
    ret matrix.FromArray(rows, cols, data)
end

func show(name: str, m &: matrix.Matrix):
    println name, matrix.ToRepr(matrix.Chop(m, 0.000001), 3)
end

func r(value: f64): str:
    ret matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.Full(1, 1, value), 3)
end

func main:
    show("Hilbert", matrix.Hilbert(2))
    show("Hilbert times its inverse", matrix.MatMul(matrix.Hilbert(3), matrix.HilbertInverse(3)))
    show("Vandermonde", matrix.Vandermonde(build(3, 1, "1 2 3"), 3))
    show("Toeplitz", matrix.Toeplitz(build(3, 1, "1 2 3"), build(1, 3, "1 4 5")))
    show("Hankel", matrix.Hankel(build(3, 1, "1 2 3"), build(1, 3, "3 4 5")))
    show("Circulant", matrix.Circulant(build(1, 3, "1 2 3")))
    show("Companion", matrix.Companion(build(1, 3, "1 -3 2")))
    show("Pascal", matrix.Pascal(3))
    show("Rotation2D", matrix.Rotation2D(0.0))
    show("Rotation3D", matrix.Rotation3D(2, 0.0))
    show("Householder", matrix.Householder(build(2, 1, "1 0")))
    show("Givens", matrix.Givens(2, 0, 1, 0.0))
    show("Permutation", matrix.Permutation(build(1, 3, "2 0 1")))

    mut rng := matrix.NewRng(7)
    println rng.next_bits() > 0, rng.next_float() < 1.0, rng.next_normal() < 10.0
    mut random := matrix.Random(2, 3, -1.0, 1.0, 5)
    println matrix.ShapeString(random), matrix.Min(random) >= -1.0, matrix.Max(random) < 1.0, matrix.AllClose(random, matrix.Random(2, 3, -1.0, 1.0, 5), 0.0)
    println matrix.ShapeString(matrix.RandomNormal(2, 2, 1))
    println matrix.IsSymmetric(matrix.RandomSymmetric(3, 1), 0.000001), matrix.IsPositiveDefinite(matrix.RandomSPD(3, 1), 0.000001), matrix.IsOrthogonal(matrix.RandomOrthogonal(3, 1), 0.00001)

    mut data := build(4, 2, "1 2 2 4 3 6 4 8")
    show("CenterColumns", matrix.CenterColumns(data))
    show("ColumnMeans", matrix.ColumnMeans(data))
    show("ColumnStds", matrix.ColumnStds(data, false))
    show("Standardize", matrix.Standardize(data, false))
    show("Covariance", matrix.Covariance(data, true))
    show("Correlation", matrix.Correlation(data))
    mut pca := matrix.PCAFit(data)
    println matrix.ShapeString(pca.components), matrix.ShapeString(pca.variances), matrix.ShapeString(pca.center)
    show("ExplainedVariance", matrix.ExplainedVariance(pca))
    show("PCATransform", matrix.Abs(matrix.PCATransform(pca, data, 1)))
    pca.free()
    mut pca2 := matrix.PCAFromSVD(data)
    show("from the SVD", matrix.ExplainedVariance(pca2))
    pca2.free()

    mut x := build(4, 1, "1 2 3 4")
    mut y := build(4, 1, "3 5 7 9")
    coefficients := matrix.LinearRegression(x, y)
    show("LinearRegression", coefficients)
    println r(matrix.RSquared(y, y))
end
```

### `Eigen`

```salam
struct Eigen
```

The eigenvalues of a general matrix.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `n` | `int = 0` | The size. |
| `re` | `Matrix` | The real part. |
| `im` | `Matrix` | The imaginary part. |
| `iterations` | `int = 0` | The number of iterations. |
| `ok` | `bool = false` | It converged. |

matrix-Eigen.salam

```salam
import matrix

func build(rows: int, cols: int, numbers: str): matrix.Matrix:
    mut data := Vector {} as Vector<f64>
    each number in numbers.split(" "):
        data.push(number.to_float())
    end
    ret matrix.FromArray(rows, cols, data)
end

func show(name: str, m &: matrix.Matrix):
    println name, matrix.ToRepr(matrix.Chop(m, 0.000001), 3)
end

func r(value: f64): str:
    ret matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.Full(1, 1, value), 3)
end

func main:
    mut symmetric := build(2, 2, "2 1 1 2")
    mut decomposition := matrix.EigSym(symmetric)
    println decomposition.ok, decomposition.n, decomposition.sweeps >= 0
    show("values", decomposition.values)
    show("EigReconstruct", matrix.EigReconstruct(decomposition))
    decomposition.free()
    show("EigValsSym", matrix.EigValsSym(symmetric))
    println r(matrix.SpectralRadiusSym(symmetric))
    show("PowSym", matrix.PowSym(symmetric, 2.0))
    show("SqrtSym squared", matrix.MatMul(matrix.SqrtSym(symmetric), matrix.SqrtSym(symmetric)))

    mut general := build(2, 2, "0 1 -2 -3")
    mut eigen := matrix.EigVals(general)
    println eigen.ok, eigen.n, matrix.ToRepr(eigen.re, 3), matrix.ToRepr(eigen.im, 3), eigen.iterations >= 0
    eigen.free()
    mut rotation := build(2, 2, "0 -1 1 0")
    mut complex := matrix.EigValsAuto(rotation)
    show("imaginary", complex.im)
    println r(matrix.SpectralRadius(general))
    show("Hessenberg", matrix.Hessenberg(build(3, 3, "1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 10")))
    show("CharPoly", matrix.CharPoly(general))
    mut vector := matrix.EigVecFor(symmetric, 3.0, 50)
    show("EigVecFor", matrix.Abs(vector))
    mut power := matrix.PowerIteration(symmetric, 100)
    mut dominant := matrix.SubMatrix(power, 0, 0, 2, 1)
    println r(power.at(2, 0)), r(matrix.Rayleigh(symmetric, dominant)), r(matrix.ShiftedInverseIteration(symmetric, 0.9, 50))

    mut m := build(3, 2, "3 0 0 4 0 0")
    mut svd := matrix.SVDecompose(m)
    println svd.ok, matrix.ShapeString(svd.u), matrix.ShapeString(svd.v)
    show("singular values", svd.s)
    svd.free()
    show("SingularValues", matrix.SingularValues(m))
    println matrix.MatrixRank(m, 0.000001)
    show("PseudoInverse", matrix.PseudoInverse(m, 0.000001))
    show("NullSpace", matrix.NullSpace(build(2, 2, "1 1 1 1"), 0.000001))
    show("ColumnSpace", matrix.Abs(matrix.ColumnSpace(build(2, 2, "1 1 1 1"), 0.000001)))
    show("LowRankApprox", matrix.LowRankApprox(build(2, 2, "3 0 0 1"), 1))

    tol := 0.000001
    identity := matrix.Eye(3)
    println matrix.IsSquare(identity), matrix.AllClose(identity, identity, tol), matrix.IsZero(matrix.Zeros(2, 2), tol), matrix.IsIdentity(identity, tol)
    println matrix.IsSymmetric(symmetric, tol), matrix.IsSkewSymmetric(rotation, tol), matrix.IsDiagonal(identity, tol)
    println matrix.IsUpperTriangular(build(2, 2, "1 2 0 3"), tol), matrix.IsLowerTriangular(build(2, 2, "1 0 2 3"), tol)
    tridiagonal := build(3, 3, "2 1 0 1 2 1 0 1 2")
    println matrix.IsBanded(tridiagonal, 1, 1, tol), matrix.LowerBandwidth(tridiagonal, tol), matrix.UpperBandwidth(tridiagonal, tol)
    println matrix.IsOrthogonal(rotation, tol), matrix.IsNormal(symmetric, tol), matrix.IsIdempotent(build(2, 2, "1 0 0 0"), tol)
    println matrix.IsInvolutory(build(2, 2, "0 1 1 0"), tol), matrix.IsNilpotent(build(2, 2, "0 1 0 0"), tol)
    println matrix.IsPositiveDefinite(symmetric, tol), matrix.IsPositiveSemiDefinite(build(2, 2, "1 1 1 1"), tol)
    println matrix.IsSingular(build(2, 2, "1 2 2 4")), matrix.IsInvertible(symmetric)
    probability := build(2, 2, "0.5 0.5 0.5 0.5")
    println matrix.IsRowStochastic(probability, tol), matrix.IsColStochastic(probability, tol), matrix.IsDoublyStochastic(probability, tol)
    println matrix.IsPermutation(build(2, 2, "0 1 1 0"), tol), matrix.IsToeplitz(tridiagonal, tol), matrix.IsHankel(build(2, 2, "1 2 2 3"), tol)
    println r(matrix.Density(tridiagonal))
end
```

### `LU`

```salam
struct LU
```

The lower upper decomposition with row swaps.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `n` | `int = 0` | The size. |
| `lu` | `Matrix` | L and U in one matrix. |
| `piv` | `Vector` | The row swaps. |
| `sign` | `int = 1` | The sign of the permutation. |
| `singular` | `bool = false` | The matrix is singular. |

matrix-Solve.salam

```salam
import matrix

func build(rows: int, cols: int, numbers: str): matrix.Matrix:
    mut data := Vector {} as Vector<f64>
    each number in numbers.split(" "):
        data.push(number.to_float())
    end
    ret matrix.FromArray(rows, cols, data)
end

func show(name: str, m &: matrix.Matrix):
    println name, matrix.ToRepr(matrix.Chop(m, 0.000001), 3)
end

func r(value: f64): str:
    ret matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.Full(1, 1, value), 3)
end

func main:
    mut a := build(3, 3, "4 1 0 1 3 1 0 1 2")
    mut b := build(3, 1, "1 2 3")
    println r(matrix.Det(a)), r(matrix.LogAbsDet(a))
    show("Solve", matrix.Solve(a, b))
    show("SolveVec", matrix.SolveVec(a, b))
    mut lu := matrix.Decompose(a)
    println lu.n, lu.piv.len(), lu.sign, lu.singular, matrix.ShapeString(lu.lu)
    show("LUSolve", matrix.LUSolve(lu, b))
    lu.free()
    mut inverse := matrix.Inverse(a)
    show("a times its inverse", matrix.MatMul(a, inverse))
    show("Adjugate", matrix.Adjugate(build(2, 2, "1 2 3 4")))
    show("Residual", matrix.Residual(a, matrix.Solve(a, b), b))

    mut qr := matrix.QRDecompose(a)
    println qr.m, qr.n, qr.full_rank, matrix.ShapeString(qr.qr), matrix.ShapeString(qr.rdiag)
    show("Q times R", matrix.MatMul(matrix.QRGetQ(qr), matrix.QRGetR(qr)))
    show("QRSolve", matrix.QRSolve(qr, b))
    qr.free()
    mut points := build(4, 2, "1 0 1 1 1 2 1 3")
    mut values := build(4, 1, "1 3 5 7")
    show("LeastSquares", matrix.LeastSquares(points, values))
    show("Orthonormalize", matrix.Gram(matrix.Orthonormalize(points)))

    show("Cholesky", matrix.Cholesky(a))
    show("SolveSPD", matrix.SolveSPD(a, b))
    show("CholeskySolve", matrix.CholeskySolve(matrix.Cholesky(a), b))
    show("InverseSPD", matrix.MatMul(a, matrix.InverseSPD(a)))
    println r(matrix.DetSPD(a)), r(matrix.LogDetSPD(a))
    mut ldl := matrix.LDLDecompose(a)
    println ldl.ok, ldl.n, matrix.ShapeString(ldl.l), matrix.ShapeString(ldl.d)
    show("LDLSolve", matrix.LDLSolve(ldl, b))
    ldl.free()
    show("Inertia", matrix.Inertia(build(2, 2, "1 0 0 -1")))

    mut singular := build(3, 3, "1 2 3 2 4 6 1 1 1")
    show("RowEchelon", matrix.RowEchelon(singular))
    show("RREF", matrix.RREF(singular))
    show("PivotColumns", matrix.PivotColumns(singular))
    println matrix.RankExact(singular), matrix.Nullity(singular)
    show("NullSpaceExact", matrix.NullSpaceExact(singular))
    show("ColumnSpaceExact", matrix.ColumnSpaceExact(singular))
    mut right := build(3, 1, "6 12 3")
    println matrix.IsConsistent(singular, right), matrix.IsConsistent(singular, build(3, 1, "1 3 3"))
    show("SolveGeneral", matrix.SolveGeneral(singular, right))

    println matrix.IsDiagonallyDominant(a)
    mut jacobi := matrix.SolveJacobi(a, b, 200, 0.00000001)
    println jacobi.converged, jacobi.iterations > 0, jacobi.residual < 0.0001
    show("Jacobi", jacobi.x)
    jacobi.free()
    each method in [1, 2, 3]:
        mut result := matrix.SolveGaussSeidel(a, b, 200, 0.00000001)
        if method == 2:
            result = matrix.SolveSOR(a, b, 1.2, 200, 0.00000001)
        else method == 3:
            result = matrix.SolveCG(a, b, 200, 0.00000001)
        end
        show("iterative", result.x)
        result.free()
    end

    mut d := build(2, 2, "1 0 0 2")
    show("Expm", matrix.Expm(matrix.Zeros(2, 2)))
    show("Sqrtm", matrix.Sqrtm(build(2, 2, "4 0 0 9")))
    show("MatrixSign", matrix.MatrixSign(build(2, 2, "2 0 0 -3")))
    show("PolyEval", matrix.PolyEval(d, build(1, 3, "1 0 1")))
    show("CayleyHamilton", matrix.CayleyHamilton(d))
    show("LogmSym", matrix.LogmSym(matrix.Eye(2)))
end
```

### `Matrix`

```salam
struct Matrix
```

A 64 bit float matrix with its elements in row order.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rows` | `int = 0` | The number of rows. |
| `cols` | `int = 0` | The number of columns. |
| `a` | `Vector` | The elements. |

matrix-Create.salam

```salam
import matrix

func build(rows: int, cols: int, numbers: str): matrix.Matrix:
    mut data := Vector {} as Vector<f64>
    each number in numbers.split(" "):
        data.push(number.to_float())
    end
    ret matrix.FromArray(rows, cols, data)
end

func main:
    mut a := build(2, 3, "1 2 3 4 5 6")
    matrix.Print(a)
    println matrix.ShapeString(a), a.rows, a.cols, a.a.len(), a.count(), a.min_dim(), a.is_square(), a.is_empty()
    println a.at(1, 2), a.flat(4)
    a.set(0, 0, 10.0)
    a.add_at(0, 1, 0.5)
    a.mul_at(0, 2, 2.0)
    a.set_flat(5, -1.0)
    matrix.PrintPrec(a, 1)
    matrix.PrintLabeled("a", a)

    println matrix.ToString(matrix.Zeros(1, 2)), matrix.ToString(matrix.Ones(1, 2)), matrix.ToString(matrix.Full(1, 2, 7.0))
    println matrix.ToString(matrix.Eye(2))
    println matrix.ToString(matrix.EyeOffset(2, 3, 1))
    mut data := Vector {} as Vector<f64>
    data.push(1.0)
    data.push(2.0)
    println matrix.ShapeString(matrix.RowVector(data)), matrix.ShapeString(matrix.ColVector(data)), matrix.ToString(matrix.Diag(data))
    mut b := matrix.Clone(a)
    matrix.SetAll(b, 0.0)
    matrix.CopyInto(b, a)
    println b.same_shape(a), b.at(0, 0)
    println matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.Arange(0.0, 1.0, 0.25), 2)
    println matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.Linspace(0.0, 1.0, 5), 2)
    println matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.Logspace(0.0, 2.0, 3, 10.0), 1)
    println matrix.ToCSV(a, 1)
    println matrix.ToRepr(a, 1)
    println matrix.MAT_EPS > 0.0, matrix.MAT_TOL > 0.0, matrix.MAT_INF > 1000.0
    matrix.Free(b)
    a.free()
end
```

matrix-Math.salam

```salam
import matrix

func build(rows: int, cols: int, numbers: str): matrix.Matrix:
    mut data := Vector {} as Vector<f64>
    each number in numbers.split(" "):
        data.push(number.to_float())
    end
    ret matrix.FromArray(rows, cols, data)
end

func show(name: str, m &: matrix.Matrix):
    println name, matrix.ToRepr(m, 1)
end

func r(value: f64): str:
    ret matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.Full(1, 1, value), 3)
end

func main:
    mut a := build(2, 2, "1 2 3 4")
    mut b := build(2, 2, "0 1 1 0")
    mut row := build(1, 2, "10 20")
    mut col := build(2, 1, "1 -1")
    show("Transpose", matrix.Transpose(a))
    show("MatMul", matrix.MatMul(a, b))
    mut out := matrix.Zeros(2, 2)
    println matrix.TransposeInto(a, out), matrix.MatMulInto(a, b, out)
    show("into", out)
    show("TransposeMul", matrix.TransposeMul(a, b))
    show("MulTranspose", matrix.MulTranspose(a, b))
    show("Gram", matrix.Gram(a))
    show("MatVec", matrix.MatVec(a, col))
    show("VecMat", matrix.VecMat(row, a))
    println matrix.Dot(col, col), matrix.Trace(a)
    show("Outer", matrix.Outer(col, col))
    show("Kron", matrix.Kron(matrix.Eye(2), matrix.Full(1, 2, 3.0)))
    show("MatPow", matrix.MatPow(a, 2))
    show("Cross3", matrix.Cross3(build(3, 1, "1 0 0"), build(3, 1, "0 1 0")))

    show("Add", matrix.Add(a, b))
    show("Sub", matrix.Sub(a, b))
    show("MulElem", matrix.MulElem(a, b))
    show("DivElem", matrix.DivElem(a, a))
    show("Neg", matrix.Neg(a))
    show("with scalars", matrix.AddScalar(matrix.SubScalar(matrix.Scale(matrix.DivScalar(a, 2.0), 4.0), 1.0), 1.0))
    mut c := matrix.Clone(a)
    matrix.AddInPlace(c, b)
    matrix.SubInPlace(c, b)
    matrix.MulElemInPlace(c, a)
    matrix.ScaleInPlace(c, 0.5)
    matrix.AddScalarInPlace(c, 1.0)
    matrix.NegInPlace(c)
    matrix.AddScaled(c, a, 2.0)
    show("in place", c)
    show("Combine", matrix.Combine(a, 2.0, b, -1.0))
    show("MaxElem", matrix.MaxElem(a, matrix.Full(2, 2, 2.5)))
    show("MinElem", matrix.MinElem(a, matrix.Full(2, 2, 2.5)))
    show("AddRowVector", matrix.AddRowVector(a, row))
    show("AddColVector", matrix.AddColVector(a, col))
    show("MulRowVector", matrix.MulRowVector(a, row))
    show("MulColVector", matrix.MulColVector(a, col))

    mut m := build(1, 4, "-2.25 0 0.5 9")
    show("Abs", matrix.Abs(m))
    show("Sqrt", matrix.Sqrt(matrix.Abs(m)))
    show("Cbrt", matrix.Cbrt(build(1, 2, "8 -27")))
    show("Floor and Ceil", matrix.HStack(matrix.Floor(m), matrix.Ceil(m)))
    show("Round and Trunc", matrix.HStack(matrix.Round(m), matrix.Trunc(m)))
    show("Sign", matrix.Sign(m))
    show("Square", matrix.Square(m))
    show("Reciprocal", matrix.Reciprocal(build(1, 2, "2 4")))
    show("PowElem", matrix.PowElem(build(1, 2, "2 3"), 3.0))
    show("Clip", matrix.Clip(m, 0.0, 1.0))
    show("MaxScalar and MinScalar", matrix.HStack(matrix.MaxScalar(m, 0.0), matrix.MinScalar(m, 0.0)))
    show("Chop", matrix.Chop(build(1, 2, "0.0000001 1"), 0.0001))
    mut zero := matrix.Zeros(1, 1)
    println matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.HStack(matrix.Exp(zero), matrix.Log(matrix.Ones(1, 1))), 3), matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.Log10(matrix.Full(1, 1, 100.0)), 3), matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.Log2(matrix.Full(1, 1, 8.0)), 3)
    println matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.HStack(matrix.Sin(zero), matrix.Cos(zero)), 3), matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.Tan(zero), 3)
    println matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.HStack(matrix.Asin(zero), matrix.Acos(matrix.Ones(1, 1))), 3), matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.Atan(zero), 3)
    println matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.HStack(matrix.Sinh(zero), matrix.Cosh(zero)), 3), matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.Tanh(zero), 3)

    println matrix.Sum(a), matrix.Prod(a), matrix.Mean(a), matrix.Min(a), matrix.Max(a), matrix.Range(a)
    k := matrix.ArgMax(a)
    println matrix.ArgMin(a), k, matrix.IndexRow(a, k), matrix.IndexCol(a, k), matrix.MaxAbs(m)
    println r(matrix.Var(a, true)), r(matrix.Std(a, false)), matrix.Median(a)
    show("RowSums", matrix.RowSums(a))
    show("ColSums", matrix.ColSums(a))
    show("RowMeans", matrix.RowMeans(a))
    show("ColMeans", matrix.ColMeans(a))
    show("RowMins and RowMaxs", matrix.HStack(matrix.RowMins(a), matrix.RowMaxs(a)))
    show("ColMins and ColMaxs", matrix.VStack(matrix.ColMins(a), matrix.ColMaxs(a)))
    show("cumulative", matrix.HStack(matrix.CumSumRows(a), matrix.CumSumCols(a)))
    show("CumProdRows", matrix.CumProdRows(a))
    println matrix.CountNonZero(b), matrix.Any(b), matrix.All(b), matrix.AllFinite(b)

    println r(matrix.NormFrobenius(a)), matrix.Norm1(a), matrix.NormInf(a), matrix.NormMax(a)
    println r(matrix.Norm2(a)), r(matrix.NormNuclear(a)), matrix.VecNorm(col, 1.0), r(matrix.Distance(col, matrix.Zeros(2, 1)))
    show("Normalize", matrix.Normalize(build(1, 2, "3 4")))
    println matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.NormalizeRows(a), 2)
    println matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.NormalizeCols(a), 2)
    println r(matrix.Cond1(a)), r(matrix.CondInf(a)), r(matrix.Cond2(a))
end
```

### `HStack`

```salam
func HStack(x &: Matrix, y &: Matrix): Matrix
```

Two matrices side by side.

matrix-Shape.salam

```salam
import matrix

func build(rows: int, cols: int, numbers: str): matrix.Matrix:
    mut data := Vector {} as Vector<f64>
    each number in numbers.split(" "):
        data.push(number.to_float())
    end
    ret matrix.FromArray(rows, cols, data)
end

func show(name: str, m &: matrix.Matrix):
    println name, matrix.ToRepr(m, 1)
end

func main:
    mut a := build(2, 3, "1 2 3 4 5 6")
    mut square := build(3, 3, "1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9")
    show("Reshape", matrix.Reshape(a, 3, 2))
    show("Flatten", matrix.Flatten(a))
    show("FlattenCol", matrix.FlattenCol(a))
    mut row := matrix.Row(a, 1)
    mut col := matrix.Col(a, 2)
    show("Row", row)
    show("Col", col)
    mut b := matrix.Clone(a)
    matrix.SetRow(b, 0, row)
    matrix.SetCol(b, 0, col)
    show("SetRow and SetCol", b)
    show("SubMatrix", matrix.SubMatrix(square, 1, 1, 2, 2))
    show("Minor", matrix.Minor(square, 0, 0))
    show("DeleteRow", matrix.DeleteRow(square, 1))
    show("DeleteCol", matrix.DeleteCol(square, 1))
    show("InsertRow", matrix.InsertRow(a, 1, matrix.Row(a, 0)))
    show("InsertCol", matrix.InsertCol(a, 0, matrix.Col(a, 2)))
    matrix.SwapRows(b, 0, 1)
    matrix.SwapCols(b, 0, 2)
    show("swapped", b)
    show("Diagonal", matrix.Diagonal(square))
    show("DiagonalOffset", matrix.DiagonalOffset(square, 1))
    mut c := matrix.Clone(square)
    matrix.SetDiagonal(c, matrix.Ones(3, 1))
    matrix.ShiftDiagonal(c, 10.0)
    show("new diagonal", matrix.Diagonal(c))
    show("HStack", matrix.HStack(a, a))
    show("VStack", matrix.VStack(a, a))
    show("Augment", matrix.Augment(square, matrix.Eye(3)))
    show("BlockDiag", matrix.BlockDiag(matrix.Eye(1), matrix.Full(1, 1, 2.0)))
    show("Triu", matrix.Triu(square, 0))
    show("Tril", matrix.Tril(square, -1))
    show("SymmetrizeUpper", matrix.SymmetrizeUpper(square))
    show("SymPart", matrix.SymPart(square))
    show("SkewPart", matrix.SkewPart(square))
    show("FlipVertical", matrix.FlipVertical(a))
    show("FlipHorizontal", matrix.FlipHorizontal(a))
    show("Rot90", matrix.Rot90(a, 1))
    show("Roll", matrix.Roll(a, 0, 1))
    show("Tile", matrix.Tile(matrix.Eye(1), 2, 2))
    show("Pad", matrix.Pad(matrix.Eye(1), 1, 0, 0, 1, 9.0))
end
```

# image

https://salamlang.github.io/Salam/std/image/

Reading, editing and saving images, and writing text on them.

This package works with images without any outside library: it reads and writes PNG, JPEG and BMP. It also reads and writes WebP, both lossy and lossless. From a GIF it reads the first frame, and it saves an image in a GIF with at most 256 colors. `Open` and `Save` work the format out from the content or the extension. Drawing, resizing, cropping, rotating and filters such as blurring and sharpening are all there.

For text, read a TrueType font with `LoadFont` and write with `DrawTextStyled`; Persian and Arabic text is shaped and laid out right to left on its own. For building social media images automatically, `DrawTextFitBox` finds the size that fits. The font example needs a font file and on the site it is only checked.

## Types

### `Image`

```salam
struct Image
```

An 8 bit RGBA image.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | `int = 0` | The width in pixels. |
| `height` | `int = 0` | The height. |
| `pixels` | `void*` | The pixels, four bytes each, row by row. |

image-Draw.salam

```salam
import image
import os

func main:
    mut img := image.New(8, 6)
    println img.width, img.height, image.IsEmpty(img), image.InBounds(img, 7, 5), image.InBounds(img, 8, 0)
    image.Fill(img, image.RGB(255, 255, 255))
    image.FillHex(img, "#202040")
    image.SetPixel(img, 0, 0, image.RGB(255, 0, 0))
    image.BlendPixel(img, 1, 0, image.RGBA(255, 255, 255, 128))
    println image.ToHex(image.GetPixel(img, 0, 0)), image.ToHex(image.GetPixel(img, 1, 0)), image.ToHexRGB(image.GetPixel(img, 2, 0))
    image.DrawLine(img, 0, 5, 7, 5, image.Gray(200))
    image.DrawRect(img, 1, 1, 4, 3, image.ParseHex("#ffcc00"))
    image.DrawRectFilled(img, 2, 2, 2, 1, image.ParseHex("#00ff00"))
    image.DrawCircle(img, 6, 2, 1, image.Gray(255))
    image.DrawCircleFilled(img, 6, 2, 0, image.Gray(10))
    println image.ToHexRGB(image.GetPixel(img, 3, 2)), image.ToHexRGB(image.GetPixel(img, 4, 5))

    color := image.ParseHex("#336699")
    println color.r, color.g, color.b, color.a, image.Luminance(color)
    println image.Equals(color, image.RGB(51, 102, 153)), image.ToHex(image.Blend(color, image.RGBA(255, 255, 255, 0)))
    println image.ToHexRGB(image.LerpColor(image.Gray(0), image.Gray(200), 0.5))

    mut labelled := image.NewFilled(40, 10, image.Gray(0))
    image.DrawText(labelled, 1, 1, "SALAM", image.Gray(255), 1)
    println image.TextWidth("SALAM", 1), image.FontWidth, image.FontHeight

    dir := os.TempDir()
    println image.Save(img, dir + "/salam_en.png"), image.SavePNG(img, dir + "/salam2_en.png"), image.SaveBMP(img, dir + "/salam_en.bmp"), image.SaveJPEG(img, dir + "/salam_en.jpg", 90)
    println image.SaveQuality(img, dir + "/salam2_en.jpg", 50), image.SaveWebP(img, dir + "/salam_en.webp")
    mut ok := false
    read := image.Open(dir + "/salam_en.png", ok)
    println ok, read.width, image.Equals(image.GetPixel(read, 0, 0), image.GetPixel(img, 0, 0))
    png := image.OpenPNG(dir + "/salam2_en.png", ok)
    bmp := image.OpenBMP(dir + "/salam_en.bmp", ok)
    jpg := image.OpenJPEG(dir + "/salam_en.jpg", ok)
    println ok, png.width, bmp.height, jpg.width
    println image.FormatFromExt("a.jpeg") == image.FormatJPEG, image.FormatFromExt("a.png") == image.FormatPNG, image.FormatFromExt("a.txt") == image.FormatUnknown

    buf := image.EncodePNG(img)
    println image.DetectFormat(buf.data, buf.len) == image.FormatPNG, image.IsWebP(buf.data, buf.len)
    from_buf := image.DecodePNG(buf.data, buf.len, ok)
    generic := image.Decode(buf.data, buf.len, ok)
    println ok, from_buf.width, generic.height
    b := image.EncodeBMP(img)
    b2 := image.DecodeBMP(b.data, b.len, ok)
    j := image.EncodeJPEG(img, 80)
    j2 := image.DecodeJPEG(j.data, j.len, ok)
    println image.DetectFormat(b.data, b.len) == image.FormatBMP, image.DetectFormat(j.data, j.len) == image.FormatJPEG, b2.width, j2.width
    any := image.Encode(img, image.FormatBMP, 90)
    web := image.EncodeWebP(img)
    lossy := image.EncodeWebPQuality(img, 75)
    println any.len == b.len, web.len > 0, image.FormatWebP
    clear := image.NewFilled(1, 1, image.RGBA(0, 0, 0, 0))
    println image.ToHex(image.GetPixel(image.FlattenAlpha(clear, image.Gray(255)), 0, 0))
    converted := image.Convert(img, image.FormatJPEG)
    println converted.width
    webp := image.DecodeWebP(web.data, web.len, ok)
    println ok, webp.width, image.Equals(image.GetPixel(webp, 1, 0), image.GetPixel(img, 1, 0))
    webp3 := image.DecodeWebP(lossy.data, lossy.len, ok)
    println ok, webp3.width, webp3.height
    webp2 := image.OpenWebP(dir + "/salam_en.webp", ok)
    println image.SaveGIF(img, dir + "/salam_en.gif"), image.FormatFromExt("a.gif") == image.FormatGIF
    gif := image.OpenGIF(dir + "/salam_en.gif", ok)
    g := image.EncodeGIF(img)
    gif2 := image.DecodeGIF(g.data, g.len, ok)
    println ok, gif.width, gif2.height, image.IsGIF(g.data, g.len), image.Equals(image.GetPixel(gif, 0, 0), image.GetPixel(img, 0, 0))
    println ok, webp2.height
    mut copy := image.Clone(img)
    image.Free(copy)
    image.Free(img)
end
```

Output:

### `Histogram`

```salam
struct Histogram
```

A histogram: how many pixels have each value from 0 to 255.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `r` | `void*` | The red histogram. |
| `g` | `void*` | The green histogram. |
| `b` | `void*` | The blue histogram. |
| `luma` | `void*` | The brightness histogram. |

image-Edit.salam

```salam
import image

func size(name: str, img: image.Image):
    println name, "" + img.width + "x" + img.height
end

func main:
    mut img := image.NewFilled(8, 4, image.Gray(100))
    image.SetPixel(img, 0, 0, image.RGB(255, 0, 0))
    size("nearest", image.ResizeNearestNeighbor(img, 4, 2))
    size("bilinear", image.ResizeBilinearFilter(img, 16, 8))
    size("resize", image.Resize(img, 2, 2, image.ResizeBilinear))
    size("near", image.Resize(img, 2, 2, image.ResizeNearest))
    size("scale", image.Scale(img, 0.5))
    size("crop", image.Crop(img, 2, 1, 3, 2))
    clockwise := image.RotateCW(img)
    size("clockwise", clockwise)
    println image.ToHexRGB(image.GetPixel(clockwise, 3, 0))
    size("counterclockwise", image.RotateCCW(img))
    println image.ToHexRGB(image.GetPixel(image.Rotate180(img), 7, 3))
    println image.ToHexRGB(image.GetPixel(image.FlipHorizontal(img), 7, 0)), image.ToHexRGB(image.GetPixel(image.FlipVertical(img), 0, 3))
    size("fit", image.ResizeFit(img, 4, 4))
    size("fill", image.ResizeFill(img, 4, 4))
    size("thumbnail", image.Thumbnail(img, 2))

    mut c := image.NewFilled(2, 1, image.RGB(200, 100, 50))
    image.Grayscale(c)
    println image.ToHexRGB(image.GetPixel(c, 0, 0))
    image.Invert(c)
    image.Brightness(c, 10)
    image.Contrast(c, 1.5)
    println image.ToHexRGB(image.GetPixel(c, 0, 0))
    image.Threshold(c, 128)
    println image.ToHexRGB(image.GetPixel(c, 0, 0))
    mut dot := image.NewFilled(5, 5, image.Gray(0))
    image.SetPixel(dot, 2, 2, image.Gray(255))
    blurred := image.Blurred(dot, 1)
    println image.GetPixel(blurred, 2, 2).r < 255, image.GetPixel(blurred, 1, 2).r > 0
    println image.GetPixel(image.Sharpened(dot, 1.0), 2, 2).r
    mut base := image.NewFilled(2, 2, image.Gray(0))
    image.Overlay(base, image.NewFilled(1, 1, image.Gray(200)), 1, 1, 0.5)
    println image.ToHexRGB(image.GetPixel(base, 1, 1)), image.ToHexRGB(image.GetPixel(base, 0, 0))

    mut hist := image.ComputeHistogram(dot)
    println image.HistogramGet(hist.luma, 0), image.HistogramGet(hist.luma, 255), image.HistogramGet(hist.r, 255), image.HistogramGet(hist.g, 0), image.HistogramGet(hist.b, 0)
    image.HistogramFree(hist)
    black := image.NewFilled(5, 5, image.Gray(0))
    diff := image.Diff(dot, black)
    println image.GetPixel(diff, 2, 2).r, image.GetPixel(diff, 0, 0).r
    println (image.MeanAbsError(dot, black) * 100.0 + 0.5) as i64, (image.PSNR(dot, black) + 0.5) as i64
end
```

Output:

```text

bilinear 16x8
resize 2x2
near 2x2
scale 4x2
crop 3x2
clockwise 4x8
#ff0000
counterclockwise 4x8
#ff0000
#ff0000 #ff0000
fit 4x4
fill 4x4
thumbnail 2x1
#7c7c7c
#939393

true true
```

### `TextStyle`

```salam
struct TextStyle
```

A text style.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `f64 = 16` | The size in pixels. |
| `rotate` | `f64 = 0` | The rotation in degrees. |
| `skew` | `f64 = 0` | The skew. |
| `tracking` | `f64 = 0` | The space added between the characters. |
| `kern` | `bool = true` | Adjust the spacing of pairs. |
| `dir` | `int = 0` | The direction, one of the `TextDir...` constants. |
| `shape` | `bool = true` | Join the Persian and Arabic letters into their connected shapes. |

image-Font.salam

```salam
import image
import io

func main:
    println image.FindSystemFont(), image.FindArabicFont()
    mut ok := false
    mut font := image.LoadSystemFont(ok)
    if not ok:
        font = image.LoadFont("Vazirmatn-Regular.ttf", ok)
    end
    if not ok:
        println "no font was found"
        ret
    end
    println image.FontValid(font), image.UnitsPerEm(font), image.NumGlyphs(font)
    size := 32.0
    println image.ScaleFactor(font, size), image.AscentPixels(font, size), image.DescentPixels(font, size), image.LineHeightPixels(font, size)
    a := image.GlyphIndex(font, 65)
    v := image.GlyphIndex(font, 86)
    println image.GlyphAdvance(font, a), image.KernAdvance(font, a, v), image.GlyphHasOutline(font, a)
    mut x0 := 0
    mut y0 := 0
    mut x1 := 0
    mut y1 := 0
    println image.GlyphBox(font, a, x0, y0, x1, y1), x1 - x0, y1 - y0

    mut img := image.NewFilled(400, 120, image.Gray(255))
    black := image.Gray(0)
    _ := image.DrawTextTTF(img, 10.0, 40.0, "Salam", black, font, size)
    println image.TextWidthTTF(font, "Salam", size)
    style := image.TextStyle { size = 28.0, tracking = 1.0, kern = true, dir = image.TextDirAuto, shape = true }
    _ := image.DrawTextStyled(img, 10.0, 80.0, "سلام دنیا", black, font, style)
    println image.TextWidthStyled(font, "سلام دنیا", style), image.TextInkWidth(font, "سلام", style), image.TextInkHeight(font, "سلام", style)
    mut width := 0.0
    mut height := 0.0
    println image.TextInkSize(font, "سلام", style, width, height), width, height
    mut a0 := 0.0
    mut b0 := 0.0
    mut a1 := 0.0
    mut b1 := 0.0
    println image.TextBounds(font, "سلام", style, a0, b0, a1, b1)
    println image.FitSizeToWidth(font, "سلام", style, 200.0, 96.0), image.FitSizeToBox(font, "سلام", style, 200.0, 50.0, 96.0)
    _ := image.DrawGlyphStyled(img, a, 300.0, 40.0, black, font, style)
    _ := image.DrawCodepointStyled(img, 1600, 340.0, 40.0, black, font, style)
    _ := image.DrawTextCentered(img, 200.0, 60.0, "middle", black, font, style)
    _ := image.DrawTextCenteredIn(img, "middle", black, font, style)
    _ := image.DrawTextInBox(img, 0.0, 0.0, 200.0, 60.0, "box", black, font, style, image.TextAlignRight, image.TextVAlignMiddle)
    _ := image.DrawTextFitBox(img, 0.0, 60.0, 200.0, 60.0, "fit", black, font, style, 0.8, 64.0)
    _ := image.DrawTextFitImage(img, "سلام", black, font, style, 0.9, 120.0)
    println image.TextAlignLeft, image.TextAlignCenter, image.TextVAlignTop, image.TextVAlignBottom, image.TextVAlignBaseline
    _ := image.Save(img, "salam-text-en.png")

    data := io.ReadFile("Vazirmatn-Regular.ttf")
    mut f2 := image.ParseFont(data as void*, data.len(), ok)
    mut f3 := image.ParseFontIndex(data as void*, data.len(), 0, ok)
    mut f4 := image.LoadFontIndex("NotoSansCJK.ttc", 0, ok)
    println image.IsCFFFont(data as void*, data.len())
    image.FreeFont(f2)
    image.FreeFont(f3)
    image.FreeFont(f4)
    image.FreeFont(font)
    image.Free(img)
end
```

### `TextDirAuto`

```salam
const TextDirAuto: i32 = 0
```

Text direction: automatic, from the first letter.

image-Bidi.salam

```salam
import image

func main:
    println image.IsRTLText("سلام"), image.IsRTLText("hello")
    println image.BaseDirection("سلام hello") == image.TextDirRTL, image.BaseDirection("hello سلام") == image.TextDirLTR
    println image.TextDirAuto
    visual := image.ToVisualOrder("abc", image.TextDirLTR)
    println visual
    shaped := image.ShapeArabic("سلام")
    println shaped.len() > 0, shaped != "سلام"
    println image.ToVisualOrder("سلام", image.TextDirRTL) != "سلام"
end
```

Output:

```text
true false
true true
0
abc
true true
true
```

# graph

https://salamlang.github.io/Salam/std/graph/

Graph theory: traversal, shortest paths, spanning trees, flow, coloring, communities and centrality.

This package has more than two hundred graph algorithms. Make a graph with `NewUndirected` or `NewDirected`, add edges with `add_edge` and `add_weighted`, then call `build`; or read the whole thing from text in one go with `FromEdgeList`. Nodes are numbered from zero to n minus one.

Everything from traversal and components to shortest paths, spanning trees, flow and cuts, matching, coloring, communities and centrality is ready to use. You can export the result with `ToDot` or `ToMermaid` to draw it. The algorithms that solve hard problems, such as maximum clique and Hamiltonian cycle, are meant for small graphs.

## Types

### `FlowNet`

```salam
struct FlowNet
```

A flow network with capacities and costs.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `n` | `int = 0` | The number of nodes. |
| `head` | `Vector` | Where each node's arcs start. |
| `to` | `Vector` | The target of each arc. |
| `cap` | `Vector` | The remaining capacity. |
| `cost` | `Vector` | The cost. |
| `orig` | `Vector` | The original capacity. |
| `nxt` | `Vector` | The next arc. |

graph-Flow.salam

```salam
import graph

func list(text: str): Vector<int>:
    mut out := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    each num in text.split(" "):
        out.push(num.to_int())
    end
    ret out
end


func ints(v: Vector<int>): str:
    mut text := "["
    repeat v.len() in i:
        if i > 0:
            text += " "
        end
        text += "" + v.get(i)
    end
    ret text + "]"
end


func main:
    mut net := graph.NewFlowNet(4)
    e := net.add_arc(0, 1, 3.0)
    _ := net.add_arc(0, 2, 2.0)
    _ := net.add_arc(1, 3, 2.0)
    _ := net.add_arc(2, 3, 3.0)
    _ := net.add_edge(1, 2, 1.0)
    println net.arc_count(), graph.MaxFlow(net, 0, 3), net.flow_on(e)
    net.reset()
    println graph.MaxFlowEdmondsKarp(net, 0, 3)
    net.reset()
    mut side := Vector {} as Vector<bool>
    println graph.MinCut(net, 0, 3, side), side.get(0), side.get(3)
    mut costly := graph.NewFlowNet(3)
    _ := costly.add_cost_arc(0, 1, 2.0, 1.0)
    _ := costly.add_cost_arc(0, 2, 2.0, 5.0)
    _ := costly.add_cost_arc(1, 2, 1.0, 1.0)
    mut sent := 0.0
    println graph.MinCostFlow(costly, 0, 2, 2.0, sent), sent
    net.free()
    mut roads := graph.FromEdgeList("0 1 3\n0 2 2\n1 3 2\n2 3 3\n1 2 1", 4, true)
    mut cut := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    println graph.MaxFlowValue(roads, 0, 3), graph.MinCutEdges(roads, 0, 3, cut), ints(cut), graph.FlowFromGraph(roads).n
    mut ring := graph.CycleGraph(5)
    println graph.GlobalMinCut(ring), graph.EdgeConnectivity(ring), graph.VertexConnectivity(graph.CompleteGraph(4))

    mut bip := graph.FromEdgeList("0 3\n0 4\n1 3\n2 5", 6, false)
    mut mate := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    println graph.BipartiteMatching(bip, mate), ints(mate), graph.MaximalMatching(ring, mate)
    mut cover := Vector {} as Vector<bool>
    println graph.MinimumVertexCover(bip, cover), graph.MaximumIndependentSetBipartite(bip, cover), graph.GreedyVertexCover(ring, cover)
    println ints(graph.MaxClique(graph.CompleteGraph(4))), graph.CliqueNumber(ring), ints(graph.MaximumIndependentSet(ring)), graph.IndependenceNumber(ring), graph.VertexCoverNumber(ring)

    color := graph.GreedyColoringNatural(ring)
    println ints(color), graph.ColorCount(color), graph.IsProperColoring(ring, color), graph.ChromaticNumber(ring), graph.ChromaticNumber(graph.PetersenGraph())
    println ints(graph.GreedyColoring(ring, list("4 3 2 1 0"))), ints(graph.WelshPowell(ring)), ints(graph.DSatur(ring))
    println ints(graph.EdgeColoringGreedy(graph.StarGraph(4))), graph.CountColorings(graph.PathGraph(3), 3)

    mut social := graph.FromEdgeList("0 1\n1 2\n2 0\n3 4\n4 5\n5 3\n2 3", 6, false)
    mut alive := Vector {} as Vector<bool>
    println graph.KCore(social, 2, alive), ints(graph.CoreNumbers(social)), graph.Degeneracy(social)
    mut group := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    println graph.Louvain(social, group), ints(group)
    println (graph.Modularity(social, group) * 100.0 + 0.5) as int
    println graph.LabelPropagation(social, group) >= 1, graph.GirvanNewman(social, 2, group), ints(group)
end
```

graph-Build.salam

```salam
import graph

func list(text: str): Vector<int>:
    mut out := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    each num in text.split(" "):
        out.push(num.to_int())
    end
    ret out
end


func ints(v: Vector<int>): str:
    mut text := "["
    repeat v.len() in i:
        if i > 0:
            text += " "
        end
        text += "" + v.get(i)
    end
    ret text + "]"
end


func main:
    mut g := graph.NewUndirected(4)
    _ := g.add_edge(0, 1)
    _ := g.add_weighted(1, 2, 2.5)
    e := g.add_edge(2, 3)
    r := g.add_node()
    g.add_nodes(1)
    _ := g.add_edge(3, r)
    g.set_weight(e, 4.0)
    g.set_name(0, "Tehran")
    g.build()
    println g.order(), g.size(), g.name(0), g.directed, g.built
    println g.edge_from(e), g.edge_to(e), g.edge_weight(e), g.weight_between(1, 2), g.has_edge(2, 1), g.find_edge(0, 3)
    println g.degree(2), g.out_degree(2), g.in_degree(2), ints(g.neighbors(2))
    repeat g.adj_start(1) to g.adj_stop(1) in k:
        println g.adj_node(k), g.adj_edge(k), g.adj_weight(k)
    end

    mut d := graph.NewDirected(3)
    _ := d.add_edge(0, 1)
    _ := d.add_edge(1, 2)
    _ := d.add_edge(2, 2)
    _ := d.add_edge(0, 1)
    d.build()
    repeat d.in_start(1) to d.in_stop(1) in k:
        println "in", d.in_node(k), d.in_edge(k)
    end
    println graph.SelfLoopCount(d), graph.HasSelfLoop(d), graph.ParallelEdgeCount(d), graph.IsSimple(d)
    mut simple := graph.Simplify(d)
    mut noloops := graph.RemoveSelfLoops(d)
    println simple.size(), noloops.size(), graph.TotalWeight(g)
    println graph.Transpose(d).has_edge(1, 0), graph.Reverse(d).has_edge(2, 1), graph.ToUndirected(d).directed, graph.ToDirected(g).size()
    general := graph.New(2, true)
    println general.directed, graph.Clone(g).size()
    mut keep := Vector {} as Vector<bool>
    graph.FillBool(keep, g.order(), true)
    keep.set(0, false)
    mut mapping := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    println graph.Subgraph(g, keep).order(), graph.SubgraphMap(g, keep, mapping).size(), ints(mapping)
    mut edges := Vector {} as Vector<bool>
    graph.FillBool(edges, g.size(), false)
    edges.set(0, true)
    println graph.EdgeSubgraph(g, edges).size(), graph.Complement(graph.PathGraph(4)).size()
    mut a := graph.PathGraph(3)
    mut b := graph.CycleGraph(3)
    println graph.Union(a, b).size(), graph.DisjointUnion(a, b).order(), graph.Intersection(a, b).size(), graph.LineGraph(b).size()

    sources := list("0 1 2")
    targets := list("1 2 0")
    mut fromedges := graph.FromEdges(3, sources, targets, true)
    println fromedges.size()
    mut text := graph.FromEdgeList("0 1 2.5\n1 2", 3, false)
    println text.weight_between(0, 1)
    println graph.ToEdgeList(text)
    println graph.ToAdjacencyList(text)
    println graph.ToMatrixText(text)
    println graph.ToDot(text)
    println graph.ToMermaid(text)
    println graph.ToJSON(text)
    println graph.Describe(text)
    println graph.IsClose(0.1 + 0.2, 0.3), graph.GRAPH_INF > 1000.0, graph.GRAPH_NONE

    println graph.EmptyGraph(3).size(), graph.CompleteGraph(4).size(), graph.CompleteBipartite(2, 3).size(), graph.StarGraph(4).size(), graph.WheelGraph(5).size()
    println graph.GridGraph(2, 3).size(), graph.HypercubeGraph(3).size(), graph.PetersenGraph().size(), graph.CirculantGraph(6, list("1 2")).size(), graph.BalancedTree(2, 2).order()
    println graph.ErdosRenyi(10, 0.5).order(), graph.RandomGraph(10, 15).size(), graph.RandomTree(8).size(), graph.BarabasiAlbert(20, 2).order(), graph.WattsStrogatz(20, 4, 0.1).order()
    g.free()
end
```

graph-Paths.salam

```salam
import graph

func list(text: str): Vector<int>:
    mut out := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    each num in text.split(" "):
        out.push(num.to_int())
    end
    ret out
end


func ints(v: Vector<int>): str:
    mut text := "["
    repeat v.len() in i:
        if i > 0:
            text += " "
        end
        text += "" + v.get(i)
    end
    ret text + "]"
end


func floats(v: Vector<f64>): str:
    mut text := "["
    repeat v.len() in i:
        if i > 0:
            text += " "
        end
        text += "" + ((v.get(i) * 100.0 + 100000.5) as int - 100000)
    end
    ret text + "]/100"
end

func main:
    mut cities := graph.FromEdgeList("0 1 4\n0 2 1\n2 1 2\n1 3 1\n2 3 5", 4, false)
    mut dist := Vector {} as Vector<f64>
    mut parent := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    println graph.Dijkstra(cities, 0, dist, parent), floats(dist), ints(parent)
    println floats(graph.DijkstraDist(cities, 0)), ints(graph.ShortestPath(cities, 0, 3)), graph.ShortestPathLength(cities, 0, 3)
    mut guess := Vector {} as Vector<f64>
    graph.FillFloat(guess, 4, 0.0)
    println ints(graph.AStar(cities, 0, 3, guess)), floats(graph.KShortestLengths(cities, 0, 3, 3))
    floyd := graph.FloydWarshall(cities)
    mut next := graph.NewIntMatrix(0, 0, 0)
    floyd2 := graph.FloydWarshallPaths(cities, next)
    println floyd.at(0, 3), floyd2.at(3, 0), ints(graph.FloydPath(next, 0, 3)), graph.Johnson(cities).at(0, 1)
    mut zeroone := graph.FromEdgeList("0 1 0\n1 2 1\n0 2 1", 3, true)
    println graph.ZeroOneBFS(zeroone, 0, dist, parent), floats(dist)

    mut negative := graph.FromEdgeList("0 1 1\n1 2 -2\n2 0 0.5", 3, true)
    println graph.BellmanFord(negative, 0, dist, parent), graph.HasNegativeCycle(negative), ints(graph.FindNegativeCycle(negative))

    mut project := graph.FromEdgeList("0 1 3\n0 2 2\n1 3 4\n2 3 1", 4, true)
    println graph.DAGShortestPath(project, 0, dist, parent), floats(dist)
    println graph.DAGLongestPath(project, 0, dist, parent), floats(dist), ints(graph.CriticalPath(project))
    println graph.CountPaths(project, 0, 3), floats(graph.PathCounts(project, 0))
    closure := graph.TransitiveClosure(project)
    println closure.at(0, 3), closure.at(3, 0), graph.TransitiveReduction(graph.FromEdgeList("0 1\n1 2\n0 2", 3, true)).size()
    mut layer := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    println graph.TopologicalLayers(project, layer), ints(layer), graph.IsTotalOrder(graph.FromEdgeList("0 1\n1 2", 3, true))
    println graph.WalkCount(graph.CycleGraph(4), 2, 0, 0)

    mut ring := graph.CycleGraph(4)
    println graph.HasEulerianCircuit(ring), ints(graph.EulerianCircuit(ring)), graph.HasEulerianPath(graph.PathGraph(3)), ints(graph.EulerianPath(graph.PathGraph(3)))
    println graph.HasHamiltonianCycle(ring), ints(graph.HamiltonianCycle(ring)), ints(graph.HamiltonianPath(graph.PathGraph(3)))
    mut full := graph.NewUndirected(4)
    each edge in ["0 1 1", "0 2 4", "0 3 3", "1 2 2", "1 3 5", "2 3 1"]:
        mut parts := list(edge)
        _ := full.add_weighted(parts.get(0), parts.get(1), parts.get(2) as f64)
    end
    full.build()
    mut tour := graph.TSPNearestNeighbor(full, 0)
    println ints(tour), graph.TourLength(full, tour), graph.TSPTwoOpt(full, tour), graph.TourLength(full, graph.TSPHeuristic(full, 0))
end
```

### `Graph`

```salam
struct Graph
```

A graph: nodes numbered 0 to n minus one and edges, directed or undirected, with optional weights. Call `build` after adding the edges.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `directed` | `bool = false` | Whether the graph is directed. |
| `n` | `int = 0` | The number of nodes. |
| `eu` | `Vector` | The start node of each edge. |
| `ev` | `Vector` | The end node of each edge. |
| `ew` | `Vector` | The edge weights. |
| `names` | `Vector` | The node names. |
| `off` | `Vector` | Where each node's adjacency list starts. |
| `nbr` | `Vector` | The adjacent nodes. |
| `eix` | `Vector` | The adjacent edges. |
| `roff` | `Vector` | Where each node's incoming list starts. |
| `rnbr` | `Vector` | The incoming nodes. |
| `reix` | `Vector` | The incoming edges. |
| `built` | `bool = false` | Whether the adjacency lists have been built. |

The example for this item is shown with the ones above: graph-Build.salam

#### `add_edge`


graph-Trees.salam

```salam
import graph

func ints(v: Vector<int>): str:
    mut text := "["
    repeat v.len() in i:
        if i > 0:
            text += " "
        end
        text += "" + v.get(i)
    end
    ret text + "]"
end


func main:
    mut net := graph.FromEdgeList("0 1 4\n0 2 1\n1 2 2\n1 3 5\n2 3 8\n3 4 3", 5, false)
    mut chosen := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    println graph.Kruskal(net, chosen), ints(chosen)
    println graph.MaximumSpanningTree(net, chosen), ints(chosen)
    mut parent := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    println graph.Prim(net, 0, parent), ints(parent), graph.Boruvka(net, chosen), graph.MSTWeight(net)
    mut tree := graph.MinimumSpanningTree(net)
    println tree.size(), graph.IsTree(tree), graph.IsForest(tree), graph.IsTree(net), graph.SpanningAgreement(net), graph.SpanningTreeCount(graph.CompleteGraph(4))

    mut order := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    graph.RootTree(tree, 0, parent, order)
    println ints(parent), ints(order), ints(graph.SubtreeSizes(tree, 0))
    mut ends := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    println graph.TreeDiameter(tree, ends), ints(ends), ints(graph.TreeCenter(tree)), ints(graph.TreeCentroid(tree))
    mut lca := graph.BuildLCA(tree, 0)
    println graph.LCA(lca, 3, 4), graph.LCA(lca, 4, 2), graph.TreeDistance(lca, 4, 2), lca.ancestor(0, 4), lca.n, lca.levels > 0
    lca.free()

    code := graph.PruferEncode(tree)
    println ints(code), graph.PruferDecode(code).size(), graph.LabeledTreeCount(5)
    println graph.TreeIsomorphic(graph.PathGraph(4), graph.StarGraph(4)), graph.TreeIsomorphic(tree, graph.PruferDecode(code))
    println graph.TreeCanonicalForm(graph.StarGraph(3)), graph.TreeToString(tree, 0)
end
```
