### `MinHeap`

```salam
struct MinHeap
```

A min-heap with float keys and integer values.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `Vector` | The keys. |
| `val` | `Vector` | The values. |

graph-Analysis.salam

```salam
import graph

func list(text: str): Vector<int>:
    mut out := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    each num in text.split(" "):
        out.push(num.to_int())
    end
    ret out
end


func ints(v: Vector<int>): str:
    mut text := "["
    repeat v.len() in i:
        if i > 0:
            text += " "
        end
        text += "" + v.get(i)
    end
    ret text + "]"
end


func floats(v: Vector<f64>): str:
    mut text := "["
    repeat v.len() in i:
        if i > 0:
            text += " "
        end
        text += "" + ((v.get(i) * 100.0 + 100000.5) as int - 100000)
    end
    ret text + "]/100"
end

func round(x: f64): int:
    ret (x * 100.0 + 100000.5) as int - 100000
end

func main:
    mut g := graph.FromEdgeList("0 1\n0 2\n1 2\n2 3\n3 4", 5, false)
    println round(graph.Density(g)), round(graph.AverageDegree(g)), graph.MaxDegree(g), graph.MinDegree(g), ints(graph.DegreeSequence(g)), ints(graph.DegreeHistogram(g))
    println graph.IsRegular(graph.CycleGraph(5)), graph.IsComplete(graph.CompleteGraph(3)), graph.Eccentricity(g, 4), ints(graph.EccentricityAll(g))
    println graph.Diameter(g), graph.Radius(g), ints(graph.Center(g)), ints(graph.Periphery(g)), round(graph.AveragePathLength(g)), graph.WienerIndex(g), graph.Girth(g)
    println round(graph.LocalClustering(g, 2)), round(graph.AverageClustering(g)), round(graph.Transitivity(g)), graph.TriangleCount(g), round(graph.Assortativity(g)), graph.CircuitRank(g), graph.WeightedDiameter(g)

    println floats(graph.DegreeCentrality(g))
    println floats(graph.ClosenessCentrality(g))
    println floats(graph.HarmonicCentrality(g))
    println floats(graph.BetweennessCentrality(g))
    println floats(graph.EdgeBetweenness(g))
    println floats(graph.EigenvectorCentrality(g, 200, 0.000001))
    println floats(graph.KatzCentrality(g, 0.1, 1.0, 200, 0.000001))
    mut web := graph.FromEdgeList("0 1\n1 2\n2 0\n3 2", 4, true)
    rank := graph.PageRank(web, 0.85, 100, 0.000001)
    println floats(rank), graph.TopNode(rank)
    println floats(graph.InDegreeCentrality(web)), floats(graph.OutDegreeCentrality(web))
    mut hubs := Vector {} as Vector<f64>
    mut auth := Vector {} as Vector<f64>
    graph.HITS(web, 100, 0.000001, hubs, auth)
    println graph.TopNode(auth)
    mut score := Vector {} as Vector<f64>
    graph.FillFloat(score, 4, 2.0)
    graph.ScaleToSum(score)
    println floats(score)

    mut path := graph.PathGraph(3)
    adj := graph.AdjacencyMatrix(path)
    println adj.rows, adj.at(0, 1), adj.trace(), adj.row_sum(1)
    println graph.WeightMatrix(path).at(1, 2), graph.DegreeMatrix(path).at(1, 1), graph.LaplacianMatrix(path).at(1, 1), round(graph.NormalizedLaplacian(path).at(0, 1)), graph.IncidenceMatrix(path).cols
    mut m := graph.NewMatrix(2, 2)
    m.set(0, 0, 2.0)
    m.add_at(1, 1, 3.0)
    println graph.Determinant(m), graph.MatrixMultiply(m, graph.MatrixIdentity(2)).at(1, 1), graph.MatrixPower(m, 2).at(0, 0)
    println floats(graph.SymmetricEigenvalues(m)), floats(graph.AdjacencySpectrum(path)), floats(graph.LaplacianSpectrum(path))
    println round(graph.SpectralRadius(path)), round(graph.AlgebraicConnectivity(path))
    mut im := graph.NewIntMatrix(2, 2, 7)
    im.set(0, 1, 3)
    println im.at(0, 1), im.at(1, 1), im.rows
    m.free()
    im.free()

    mut a := graph.CycleGraph(5)
    mut b := graph.PetersenGraph()
    mut mapping := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    println graph.Isomorphic(a, graph.CycleGraph(5)), graph.IsomorphismMap(a, graph.CycleGraph(5), mapping), graph.AutomorphismCount(a), graph.SameDegreeSequence(a, b)
    println graph.IsGraphical(list("2 2 2")), graph.IsGraphical(list("3 1")), graph.HavelHakimi(list("2 2 2")).size()

    mut heap := graph.MinHeap {}
    heap.push(3.0, 30)
    heap.push(1.0, 10)
    heap.push(2.0, 20)
    println heap.size(), heap.top_key(), heap.top_value(), heap.pop(), heap.pop(), heap.is_empty()
    heap.clear()
    println heap.is_empty()
    heap.free()
    mut sets := graph.NewDisjointSet(5)
    println sets.union(0, 1), sets.union(1, 2), sets.union(0, 2), sets.connected(0, 2), sets.set_size(0), sets.count(), sets.find(2) == sets.find(0)
    sets.reset(3)
    println sets.count()
    sets.free()
    mut nums := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    graph.Iota(nums, 4)
    graph.ReverseInt(nums)
    println ints(nums), graph.MaxInt(nums), graph.SumInt(nums)
    graph.FillInt(nums, 3, 7)
    mut fl := Vector {} as Vector<f64>
    graph.FillFloat(fl, 2, 1.5)
    println ints(nums), graph.SumFloat(fl)
end
```

### `BFSFrom`

graph-Search.salam

```salam
import graph

func ints(v: Vector<int>): str:
    mut text := "["
    repeat v.len() in i:
        if i > 0:
            text += " "
        end
        text += "" + v.get(i)
    end
    ret text + "]"
end


func main:
    mut g := graph.FromEdgeList("0 1\n1 2\n2 0\n2 3\n4 5", 6, false)
    println ints(graph.BFS(g, 0)), ints(graph.BFSOrder(g, 0)), ints(graph.DFSOrder(g, 0)), ints(graph.DFSPostOrder(g, 0))
    mut dist := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    mut parent := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    graph.BFSFrom(g, 0, dist, parent)
    println ints(dist), ints(graph.PathFromParents(parent, 0, 3)), ints(graph.DFSForest(g))
    println graph.ReachableCount(g, 0), graph.Reachable(g, 4).get(5), graph.HopDistance(g, 0, 3), graph.HopDistance(g, 0, 4), ints(graph.HopPath(g, 1, 3))
    mut comp := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    println graph.Components(g, comp), ints(comp), graph.ComponentCount(g), ints(graph.ComponentSizes(g)), graph.IsConnected(g)
    mut color := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    println graph.IsBipartite(graph.CycleGraph(4), color), ints(color), graph.Bipartite(g)
    println ints(graph.FindCycle(g)), graph.HasCycle(g)
    println ints(graph.Bridges(g)), ints(graph.ArticulationPoints(g))
    mut bicomp := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    println graph.BiconnectedComponents(g, bicomp), ints(bicomp), graph.IsBiconnected(graph.CycleGraph(5)), graph.IsTwoEdgeConnected(graph.CycleGraph(5))
    mut twoedge := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    println graph.TwoEdgeComponents(g, twoedge), ints(twoedge)
    hops := graph.AllPairsHops(graph.PathGraph(3))
    println hops.at(0, 2), hops.rows

    mut tasks := graph.FromEdgeList("0 1\n0 2\n1 3\n2 3\n3 4", 5, true)
    mut order := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    println graph.TopologicalSort(tasks, order), ints(order)
    println graph.TopologicalSortLex(tasks, order), ints(order), graph.IsDAG(tasks)
    mut cyclic := graph.FromEdgeList("0 1\n1 2\n2 0\n2 3\n3 4\n4 3", 5, true)
    mut strong := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    println graph.StronglyConnected(cyclic, strong), ints(strong), graph.SCCCount(cyclic), graph.IsStronglyConnected(cyclic)
    mut kosa := Vector {} as Vector<int>
    println graph.Kosaraju(cyclic, kosa)
    dag := graph.Condensation(cyclic, strong)
    println dag.order(), dag.size()
end
```

# ml

https://salamlang.github.io/Salam/std/ml/

Classic machine learning: preprocessing, regression, classification, trees, clustering and evaluation.

This package gives you the classic machine learning algorithms behind an interface much like scikit-learn. The data is a matrix where each row is a sample and each column a feature, and the labels are a one-column matrix. Every model is a struct: build it with its parameters, train it with `fit` and use it with `predict`.

Before training, prepare the data with `StandardScaler` and `SimpleImputer` and split it with `TrainTestSplit`; after that, measure the model with metrics such as `Accuracy`, `F1` and `R2Score`, and pick the parameters with `GridSearch`. For neural networks see nn.

## Types

### `Split`

```salam
struct Split
```

Data after a split.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x_train` | `matrix.Matrix` | The training features. |
| `x_test` | `matrix.Matrix` | The test features. |
| `y_train` | `matrix.Matrix` | The training labels. |
| `y_test` | `matrix.Matrix` | The test labels. |

ml-Prep.salam

```salam
import ml
import matrix

func build(rows: int, cols: int, numbers: str): matrix.Matrix:
    mut data := Vector {} as Vector<f64>
    each number in numbers.split(" "):
        data.push(number.to_float())
    end
    ret matrix.FromArray(rows, cols, data)
end

func show(name: str, m &: matrix.Matrix):
    println name, matrix.ToRepr(matrix.Chop(m, 0.000001), 3)
end

func ints(v: Vector<int>): str:
    mut text := "["
    repeat v.len() in i:
        if i > 0:
            text += " "
        end
        text += "" + v.get(i)
    end
    ret text + "]"
end

func main:
    mut data := build(4, 2, "1 10 2 20 3 30 4 40")
    mut standard := ml.StandardScaler {}
    mut scaled := standard.fit_transform(data)
    show("standard", scaled)
    show("mean", standard.mean)
    println standard.ok, standard.with_mean, standard.with_std, matrix.ShapeString(standard.std)
    show("back", standard.inverse_transform(scaled))
    mut minmax := ml.MinMaxScaler { lo = 0.0, hi = 1.0 }
    println minmax.fit(data)
    show("minmax", minmax.transform(data))
    show("back", minmax.inverse_transform(minmax.fit_transform(data)))
    println minmax.ok, matrix.ShapeString(minmax.data_min), matrix.ShapeString(minmax.data_range)
    println standard.fit(data), matrix.ShapeString(standard.transform(data))

    mut labels := Vector {} as Vector<str>
    each label in ["cat", "dog", "cat", "fish"]:
        labels.push(label)
    end
    mut encoder := ml.LabelEncoder {}
    mut codes := encoder.fit_transform(labels)
    show("label", codes)
    println encoder.ok, encoder.classes.len(), encoder.index_of("dog"), encoder.inverse_transform(codes).get(3), encoder.fit(labels), matrix.ShapeString(encoder.transform(labels))
    mut onehot := ml.OneHotEncoder {}
    mut hot := onehot.fit_transform(codes)
    show("onehot", hot)
    show("back", onehot.inverse_transform(hot))
    println onehot.ok, onehot.n_classes, onehot.fit(codes), matrix.ShapeString(onehot.transform(codes))
    println ints(ml.LabelsToInts(codes)), ml.CountClasses(codes)

    mut missing := build(3, 2, "1 4 nan 6 3 nan")
    mut imputer := ml.SimpleImputer { strategy = ml.IMPUTE_MEAN }
    show("mean", imputer.fit_transform(missing))
    mut imputer2 := ml.SimpleImputer { strategy = ml.IMPUTE_CONSTANT, fill = -1.0 }
    println imputer2.fit(missing), imputer2.ok, matrix.ShapeString(imputer2.stats)
    show("constant", imputer2.transform(missing))
    println ml.IMPUTE_MEDIAN
    mut poly := ml.PolynomialFeatures { degree = 2, include_bias = true }
    show("polynomial", poly.transform(build(1, 2, "2 3")))

    mut linear := build(4, 2, "1 2 2 4 3 6 4 8")
    mut pca := ml.PCA { n_components = 1 }
    println pca.fit(linear), pca.ok, matrix.ShapeString(pca.components), matrix.ShapeString(pca.mean)
    show("variance", pca.explained_ratio)
    println matrix.ShapeString(pca.explained_variance), matrix.ShapeString(pca.transform(linear)), matrix.ShapeString(pca.fit_transform(linear))
    show("back", pca.inverse_transform(pca.transform(linear)))
    mut svd := ml.TruncatedSVD { n_components = 1 }
    println svd.fit(linear), svd.ok, matrix.ShapeString(svd.components), matrix.ShapeString(svd.singular_values), matrix.ShapeString(svd.explained_variance), matrix.ShapeString(svd.explained_ratio)
    println matrix.ShapeString(svd.transform(linear)), matrix.ShapeString(svd.fit_transform(linear))

    mut x := build(6, 1, "1 2 3 4 5 6")
    mut y := build(6, 1, "0 0 0 1 1 1")
    mut split := ml.TrainTestSplit(x, y, 0.5, 7)
    println matrix.ShapeString(split.x_train), matrix.ShapeString(split.x_test), matrix.ShapeString(split.y_train), matrix.ShapeString(split.y_test)
    mut folds := ml.KFold(6, 3, false, 0)
    println folds.count(), ints(folds.test.get(0)), ints(folds.train.get(0))
    mut stratified := ml.StratifiedKFold(y, 3, 1)
    println stratified.count(), stratified.test.get(0).len()
    println ml.ML_TOL > 0.0
    standard.free()
    minmax.free()
    encoder.free()
    imputer.free()
    pca.free()
    svd.free()
end
```

Output:


### `GridResult`

```salam
struct GridResult
```

The result of a grid search.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scores` | `Vector` | The mean score of each candidate. |
| `best` | `int = -1` | The number of the best one. |
| `best_score` | `f64 = 0` | The best score. |

ml-Select.salam

```salam
import ml
import matrix

func build(rows: int, cols: int, numbers: str): matrix.Matrix:
    mut data := Vector {} as Vector<f64>
    each number in numbers.split(" "):
        data.push(number.to_float())
    end
    ret matrix.FromArray(rows, cols, data)
end

func f3(number: f64): str:
    ret matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.Full(1, 1, number), 3)
end

func neighbors(k: int, train: matrix.Matrix, labels: matrix.Matrix, test: matrix.Matrix): matrix.Matrix:
    mut model := ml.KNNClassifier { k = k }
    _ := model.fit(train, labels)
    pred := model.predict(test)
    model.free()
    ret pred
end

func main:
    mut x := build(8, 2, "1 1 1 2 2 1 2 2 6 6 6 7 7 6 7 7")
    mut y := build(8, 1, "0 0 0 0 1 1 1 1")
    mut folds := ml.StratifiedKFold(y, 4, 1)
    mut scores := ml.CrossValScore((a: matrix.Matrix, b: matrix.Matrix, c: matrix.Matrix): ret neighbors(1, a, b, c) end, (a: matrix.Matrix, b: matrix.Matrix): ret ml.Accuracy(a, b) end, x, y, folds)
    println scores.len(), f3(ml.MeanScore(scores))
    mut parallel := ml.CrossValScoreParallel((a: matrix.Matrix, b: matrix.Matrix, c: matrix.Matrix): ret neighbors(1, a, b, c) end, (a: matrix.Matrix, b: matrix.Matrix): ret ml.Accuracy(a, b) end, x, y, folds, 2)
    println f3(ml.MeanScore(parallel))

    mut candidates := Vector {} as Vector<ml.Candidate>
    candidates.push(ml.Candidate { name = "k=1", fit = (a: matrix.Matrix, b: matrix.Matrix, c: matrix.Matrix): ret neighbors(1, a, b, c) end })
    candidates.push(ml.Candidate { name = "k=3", fit = (a: matrix.Matrix, b: matrix.Matrix, c: matrix.Matrix): ret neighbors(3, a, b, c) end })
    mut result := ml.GridSearch(candidates, (a: matrix.Matrix, b: matrix.Matrix): ret ml.Accuracy(a, b) end, x, y, folds, 1)
    println result.scores.len(), result.best >= 0, f3(result.best_score), candidates.get(result.best).name.len() > 0
end
```

Output:

```text
4 1.000
1.000
2 true 1.000 true
```

### `KNNClassifier`

```salam
struct KNNClassifier
```

A k nearest neighbours classifier.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `k` | `int = 5` | The number of neighbours or clusters. |
| `weighted` | `bool = false` | Weights the neighbours by inverse distance. |
| `algorithm` | `int` | The search method, one of the `KNN_...` constants. |
| `leaf_size` | `int = 16` | The leaf size of the k-d tree. |
| `workers` | `int = 0` | The number of threads; zero means automatic. |
| `xtrain` | `matrix.Matrix` | The training data. |
| `ytrain` | `matrix.Matrix` | The training labels. |
| `tree` | `KDTree` | The k-d tree. |
| `n_classes` | `int = 0` | The number of classes. |
| `ok` | `bool = false` | Whether the fit succeeded. |

ml-Classify.salam

```salam
import ml
import matrix

func build(rows: int, cols: int, numbers: str): matrix.Matrix:
    mut data := Vector {} as Vector<f64>
    each number in numbers.split(" "):
        data.push(number.to_float())
    end
    ret matrix.FromArray(rows, cols, data)
end

func show(name: str, m &: matrix.Matrix):
    println name, matrix.ToRepr(matrix.Chop(m, 0.000001), 3)
end

func f3(number: f64): str:
    ret matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.Full(1, 1, number), 3)
end

func main:
    mut x := build(8, 2, "1 1 1 2 2 1 2 2 6 6 6 7 7 6 7 7")
    mut y := build(8, 1, "0 0 0 0 1 1 1 1")
    mut test := build(2, 2, "1.5 1.5 6.5 6.5")

    mut knn := ml.KNNClassifier { k = 3, weighted = true, algorithm = ml.KNN_KDTREE }
    println knn.fit(x, y), knn.ok, knn.n_classes, knn.leaf_size, knn.workers, matrix.ShapeString(knn.xtrain), matrix.ShapeString(knn.ytrain), knn.tree.ok
    show("neighbors", knn.predict(test))
    println matrix.ShapeString(knn.predict_proba(test)), f3(knn.score(x, y)), ml.KNN_BRUTE
    mut regressor := ml.KNNRegressor { k = 2 }
    println regressor.fit(x, y), regressor.ok, regressor.weighted, regressor.algorithm, regressor.leaf_size, regressor.workers, matrix.ShapeString(regressor.xtrain), matrix.ShapeString(regressor.ytrain), regressor.tree.ok
    show("regressor", regressor.predict(test))
    println f3(regressor.score(x, y))

    mut gaussian := ml.GaussianNB {}
    println gaussian.fit(x, y), gaussian.ok, gaussian.n_classes, gaussian.var_smoothing > 0.0, matrix.ShapeString(gaussian.means), matrix.ShapeString(gaussian.vars), matrix.ShapeString(gaussian.log_priors)
    show("gaussian", gaussian.predict(test))
    println matrix.ShapeString(gaussian.predict_proba(test)), f3(gaussian.score(x, y))
    mut counts := build(4, 3, "3 0 1 2 0 0 0 3 1 0 2 2")
    mut topic := build(4, 1, "0 0 1 1")
    mut multinomial := ml.MultinomialNB { alpha = 1.0 }
    println multinomial.fit(counts, topic), multinomial.ok, multinomial.fit_prior, multinomial.n_classes, matrix.ShapeString(multinomial.log_prob), matrix.ShapeString(multinomial.log_priors)
    show("multinomial", multinomial.predict(counts))
    println matrix.ShapeString(multinomial.decision(counts)), matrix.ShapeString(multinomial.predict_proba(counts)), f3(multinomial.score(counts, topic))

    mut lda := ml.LDA {}
    println lda.fit(x, y), lda.ok, lda.n_classes, lda.ridge > 0.0, matrix.ShapeString(lda.means), matrix.ShapeString(lda.cov), matrix.ShapeString(lda.log_priors)
    show("linear", lda.predict(test))
    println matrix.ShapeString(lda.predict_proba(test)), f3(lda.score(x, y))
    mut qda := ml.QDA {}
    println qda.fit(x, y), qda.ok, qda.n_classes, qda.ridge > 0.0, matrix.ShapeString(qda.means), qda.covs.len(), matrix.ShapeString(qda.log_priors)
    show("quadratic", qda.predict(test))
    println matrix.ShapeString(qda.predict_proba(test)), f3(qda.score(x, y))

    mut svm := ml.LinearSVM { c = 1.0 }
    println svm.fit(x, y), svm.ok, svm.n_classes, svm.max_iter, svm.tol > 0.0, svm.seed, matrix.ShapeString(svm.coef), matrix.ShapeString(svm.intercept)
    show("linear svm", svm.predict(test))
    println matrix.ShapeString(svm.decision(test)), f3(svm.score(x, y))
    mut rbf := ml.SVC { kernel = ml.KERNEL_RBF, c = 10.0, gamma = 0.5 }
    println rbf.fit(x, y), rbf.ok, rbf.n_classes, rbf.n_support() > 0, rbf.degree, rbf.coef0, rbf.max_passes, rbf.tol > 0.0, rbf.seed
    println matrix.ShapeString(rbf.support), matrix.ShapeString(rbf.dual), matrix.ShapeString(rbf.bias)
    show("rbf kernel", rbf.predict(test))
    println matrix.ShapeString(rbf.decision(test)), f3(rbf.score(x, y)), ml.KERNEL_LINEAR, ml.KERNEL_POLY

    mut truth := build(6, 1, "0 0 1 1 1 0")
    mut pred := build(6, 1, "0 1 1 1 0 0")
    mut score := build(6, 1, "0.1 0.6 0.8 0.9 0.4 0.2")
    println f3(ml.Accuracy(truth, pred)), f3(ml.Precision(truth, pred, 1.0)), f3(ml.Recall(truth, pred, 1.0)), f3(ml.F1(truth, pred, 1.0)), f3(ml.MacroF1(truth, pred, 2))
    show("confusion", ml.ConfusionMatrix(truth, pred, 2))
    println f3(ml.RocAuc(truth, score)), f3(ml.AveragePrecision(truth, score)), f3(ml.BalancedAccuracy(truth, pred)), f3(ml.MatthewsCorrCoef(truth, pred)), f3(ml.CohenKappa(truth, pred))
    println matrix.ShapeString(ml.RocCurve(truth, score)), matrix.ShapeString(ml.PrecisionRecallCurve(truth, score))
    mut proba := build(6, 2, "0.9 0.1 0.4 0.6 0.2 0.8 0.1 0.9 0.6 0.4 0.8 0.2")
    println f3(ml.LogLoss(truth, proba))
    knn.free()
    regressor.free()
    gaussian.free()
    multinomial.free()
    lda.free()
    qda.free()
    svm.free()
    rbf.free()
end
```

```text
0.415
```

### `GaussianMixture`

```salam
struct GaussianMixture
```

A Gaussian mixture model, fitted with EM.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `k` | `int = 2` | The number of neighbours or clusters. |
| `max_iter` | `int = 100` | The maximum number of iterations. |
| `tol` | `f64 = 0.0001` | The convergence tolerance. |
| `var_floor` | `f64 = 1e-06` | The minimum variance. |
| `seed` | `i64 = 42` | The random seed, for a repeatable result. |
| `means` | `matrix.Matrix` | The mean of each class. |
| `vars` | `matrix.Matrix` | The variances. |
| `weights` | `matrix.Matrix` | The weight of each component. |
| `log_likelihood` | `f64 = 0` | The log likelihood. |
| `n_iter` | `int = 0` | The number of iterations run. |
| `ok` | `bool = false` | Whether the fit succeeded. |

ml-Cluster.salam

```salam
import ml
import matrix

func build(rows: int, cols: int, numbers: str): matrix.Matrix:
    mut data := Vector {} as Vector<f64>
    each number in numbers.split(" "):
        data.push(number.to_float())
    end
    ret matrix.FromArray(rows, cols, data)
end

func f3(number: f64): str:
    ret matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.Full(1, 1, number), 3)
end

func main:
    mut x := build(8, 2, "1 1 1 2 2 1 2 2 8 8 8 9 9 8 9 9")
    mut truth := build(8, 1, "0 0 0 0 1 1 1 1")

    mut km := ml.KMeans { k = 2, seed = 1 }
    mut labels := km.fit_predict(x)
    println km.ok, km.n_iter > 0, f3(km.inertia), matrix.ShapeString(km.centers), km.max_iter, km.tol > 0.0, km.n_init, km.workers
    println labels.at(0, 0) != labels.at(4, 0), f3(ml.AdjustedRandIndex(labels, truth)), f3(ml.SilhouetteScore(x, labels))
    println km.fit(x), matrix.ShapeString(km.predict(x))
    mut mini := ml.MiniBatchKMeans { k = 2, batch_size = 4, max_iter = 50, seed = 2 }
    println mini.fit(x), mini.ok, matrix.ShapeString(mini.centers), f3(ml.AdjustedRandIndex(mini.fit_predict(x), truth)), matrix.ShapeString(mini.predict(x))

    mut density := ml.DBSCAN { eps = 1.5, min_samples = 3 }
    mut clusters := density.fit_predict(x)
    println density.ok, density.n_clusters, matrix.ShapeString(density.labels), f3(ml.AdjustedRandIndex(clusters, truth)), density.fit(x)

    mut agg := ml.Agglomerative { n_clusters = 2, linkage = ml.LINK_AVERAGE }
    println f3(ml.AdjustedRandIndex(agg.fit_predict(x), truth)), agg.ok, matrix.ShapeString(agg.labels), agg.fit(x)
    println ml.LINK_SINGLE, ml.LINK_COMPLETE

    mut mixture := ml.GaussianMixture { k = 2, seed = 3 }
    println f3(ml.AdjustedRandIndex(mixture.fit_predict(x), truth)), mixture.ok, mixture.n_iter > 0, mixture.log_likelihood != 0.0, mixture.max_iter, mixture.tol > 0.0, mixture.var_floor > 0.0
    println matrix.ShapeString(mixture.means), matrix.ShapeString(mixture.vars), matrix.ShapeString(mixture.weights), mixture.fit(x)
    println matrix.ShapeString(mixture.predict(x)), matrix.ShapeString(mixture.predict_proba(x))

    mut tsne := ml.TSNE { n_components = 2, perplexity = 2.0, n_iter = 250, seed = 4 }
    mut embedded := tsne.fit_transform(x)
    println tsne.ok, matrix.ShapeString(embedded), matrix.ShapeString(tsne.embedding), tsne.kl >= 0.0, tsne.learning_rate, tsne.early_exaggeration
    km.free()
    mini.free()
    density.free()
    agg.free()
    mixture.free()
    tsne.free()
end
```

```text
true true 2x2 1.000 8x1
true 2 8x1 1.000 true
1.000 true 8x1 true
0 1
1.000 true true true 100 true true
2x2 2x2 2x1 true
8x1 8x2
true 8x2 8x2 true 0 12
```

### `QDA`

```salam
struct QDA
```

Quadratic discriminant analysis, with a separate covariance for each class.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ridge` | `f64 = 1e-06` | Covariance regularisation, for stability. |
| `means` | `matrix.Matrix` | The mean of each class. |
| `covs` | `Vector` | The covariance of each class. |
| `log_priors` | `matrix.Matrix` | The log prior probability of each class. |
| `n_classes` | `int = 0` | The number of classes. |

### `RandomForest`

```salam
struct RandomForest
```

A random forest: many trees on random samples.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `n_trees` | `int = 100` | The number of trees. |
| `criterion` | `int` | The split criterion, one of the `TREE_...` constants. |
| `max_depth` | `int = 16` | The maximum tree depth. |
| `min_samples_leaf` | `int = 1` | The minimum number of samples in a leaf. |
| `max_features` | `int = 0` | How many features each split tries; zero means all of them. |
| `bootstrap` | `bool = true` | Sample with replacement. |
| `seed` | `i64 = 42` | The random seed, for a repeatable result. |
| `workers` | `int = 0` | The number of threads; zero means automatic. |
| `trees` | `Vector` | The trees. |
| `n_classes` | `int = 0` | The number of classes. |
| `ok` | `bool = false` | Whether the fit succeeded. |

ml-Trees.salam

```salam
import ml
import matrix

func build(rows: int, cols: int, numbers: str): matrix.Matrix:
    mut data := Vector {} as Vector<f64>
    each number in numbers.split(" "):
        data.push(number.to_float())
    end
    ret matrix.FromArray(rows, cols, data)
end

func show(name: str, m &: matrix.Matrix):
    println name, matrix.ToRepr(matrix.Chop(m, 0.000001), 3)
end

func f3(number: f64): str:
    ret matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.Full(1, 1, number), 3)
end

func ints(v: Vector<int>): str:
    mut text := "["
    repeat v.len() in i:
        if i > 0:
            text += " "
        end
        text += "" + v.get(i)
    end
    ret text + "]"
end

func main:
    mut x := build(8, 2, "1 1 1 2 2 1 2 2 6 6 6 7 7 6 7 7")
    mut y := build(8, 1, "0 0 0 0 1 1 1 1")
    mut test := build(2, 2, "1.5 1.5 6.5 6.5")

    mut tree := ml.DecisionTree { criterion = ml.TREE_GINI, max_depth = 3 }
    println tree.fit(x, y), tree.ok, tree.n_classes, tree.is_regression(), tree.node_count(), tree.apply_row(test, 0) >= 0
    println tree.min_samples_split, tree.min_samples_leaf, tree.max_features, tree.seed, tree.n_classes_hint, tree.feature.len(), tree.threshold.len(), tree.left.len(), tree.right.len(), matrix.ShapeString(tree.value)
    show("tree", tree.predict(test))
    println matrix.ShapeString(tree.predict_proba(test)), f3(tree.score(x, y))
    mut regression := ml.DecisionTree { criterion = ml.TREE_MSE }
    println regression.fit(x, build(8, 1, "1 1 1 1 5 5 5 5")), regression.is_regression(), ml.TREE_ENTROPY

    mut forest := ml.RandomForest { n_trees = 20, max_depth = 4, seed = 3 }
    println forest.fit(x, y), forest.ok, forest.n_classes, forest.trees.len(), forest.is_regression(), forest.criterion, forest.min_samples_leaf, forest.max_features, forest.bootstrap, forest.workers
    show("forest", forest.predict(test))
    println matrix.ShapeString(forest.predict_proba(test)), f3(forest.score(x, y))
    forest.free_trees()

    mut ada := ml.AdaBoost { n_estimators = 10 }
    println ada.fit(x, y), ada.ok, ada.n_classes, ada.trees.len() > 0, ada.alphas.len() > 0, ada.max_depth, ada.learning_rate, ada.seed
    show("adaboost", ada.predict(test))
    println f3(ada.score(x, y))
    ada.free_all()

    mut boost := ml.GradientBoosting { n_estimators = 20, learning_rate = 0.3, max_depth = 2 }
    println boost.fit(x, y), boost.ok, boost.n_classes, boost.trees.len(), boost.min_samples_leaf, boost.regression, matrix.ShapeString(boost.base)
    show("gradient boosting", boost.predict(test))
    println matrix.ShapeString(boost.decision(test)), matrix.ShapeString(boost.predict_proba(test)), f3(boost.score(x, y))
    boost.free_all()

    mut hist := ml.HistGradientBoosting { n_estimators = 20, min_samples_leaf = 1, max_bins = 16 }
    println hist.fit(x, y), hist.ok, hist.n_classes, hist.trees.len() > 0, hist.max_depth, hist.l2, hist.learning_rate, hist.regression, hist.edges.len() > 0, hist.edges_start.len(), hist.base.len()
    show("histogram", hist.predict(test))
    println matrix.ShapeString(hist.decision(test)), matrix.ShapeString(hist.predict_proba(test)), f3(hist.score(x, y))
    mut first := hist.trees.get(0)
    println first.feature.len() > 0, first.threshold.len() > 0, first.left.len() > 0, first.right.len() > 0, first.value.len() > 0
    hist.free_all()

    mut kd := ml.NewKDTree(x, 2)
    mut dists := Vector {} as Vector<f64>
    println kd.ok, kd.leaf_size, kd.node_count() > 0, ints(kd.query(test, 1, 2, dists)), f3(dists.get(0))
    println matrix.ShapeString(kd.x), kd.idx.len(), kd.node_lo.len() > 0, kd.node_hi.len() > 0, kd.node_dim.len() > 0, kd.node_split.len() > 0, kd.node_left.len() > 0, kd.node_right.len() > 0
    mut empty := ml.KDTree {}
    println empty.build(x), empty.node_count() > 0
    kd.free()
    empty.free()
    tree.free()
    regression.free()
end
```

Output:

```text
true true 2 false 3 true
2 1 0 42 0 3 3 3 3 3x2
tree [0.000; 1.000]
2x2 1.000
true true 1
true true 2 20 false 0 1 0 true 0
forest [0.000; 1.000]
2x2 1.000
true true 2 true true 1 1 42
adaboost [0.000; 1.000]
1.000
true true 2 40 1 false 1x2
gradient boosting [0.000; 1.000]
2x2 2x2 1.000
true true 2 true 6 1 0.1 false true 3 2
histogram [0.000; 1.000]
2x2 2x2 1.000
true true true true true
true 2 true [4 5] 0.500
8x2 8 true true true true true true
true true
```

### `LinearReg`

```salam
struct LinearReg
```

Linear regression by least squares.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fit_intercept` | `bool = true` | Whether to fit an intercept too. |
| `coef` | `matrix.Matrix` | The coefficients. |
| `intercept` | `f64 = 0` | The intercept. |
| `ok` | `bool = false` | Whether the fit succeeded. |

ml-Linear.salam

```salam
import ml
import matrix

func build(rows: int, cols: int, numbers: str): matrix.Matrix:
    mut data := Vector {} as Vector<f64>
    each number in numbers.split(" "):
        data.push(number.to_float())
    end
    ret matrix.FromArray(rows, cols, data)
end

func show(name: str, m &: matrix.Matrix):
    println name, matrix.ToRepr(matrix.Chop(m, 0.000001), 3)
end

func f3(number: f64): str:
    ret matrix.ToStringPrec(matrix.Full(1, 1, number), 3)
end

func main:
    mut x := build(5, 2, "1 0 2 1 3 0 4 1 5 0")
    mut y := build(5, 1, "3 6 7 10 11")
    mut linear := ml.LinearReg {}
    println linear.fit(x, y), linear.ok, linear.fit_intercept, f3(linear.intercept)
    show("coefficients", linear.coef)
    mut pred := linear.predict(x)
    show("prediction", pred)
    println f3(linear.score(x, y)), f3(ml.R2Score(y, pred))
    mut guess := build(5, 1, "3.5 5.5 7 10 12")
    println f3(ml.MSE(y, guess)), f3(ml.MAE(y, guess)), f3(ml.RMSE(y, guess))
    println f3(ml.MedianAbsoluteError(y, guess)), f3(ml.MAPE(y, guess)), f3(ml.ExplainedVariance(y, guess))

    mut ridge := ml.Ridge { alpha = 1.0 }
    println ridge.fit(x, y), ridge.ok, ridge.alpha, ridge.fit_intercept, f3(ridge.intercept)
    show("ridge", ridge.coef)
    println ridge.score(x, y) > 0.9, matrix.ShapeString(ridge.predict(x))
    mut lasso := ml.Lasso { alpha = 0.1 }
    println lasso.fit(x, y), lasso.ok, lasso.alpha, lasso.l1_ratio, lasso.fit_intercept, lasso.max_iter, lasso.tol > 0.0, lasso.n_iter > 0, lasso.intercept > 0.0
    show("lasso", lasso.coef)
    println lasso.score(x, y) > 0.9, matrix.ShapeString(lasso.predict(x))
    mut elastic := ml.NewElasticNet(0.1, 0.5)
    println elastic.fit(x, y), elastic.l1_ratio

    mut hours := build(6, 1, "1 2 3 4 5 6")
    mut passed := build(6, 1, "0 0 0 1 1 1")
    mut logistic := ml.LogisticRegression { alpha = 0.01, max_iter = 2000 }
    println logistic.fit(hours, passed), logistic.ok, logistic.n_classes, logistic.fit_intercept, logistic.n_iter > 0, logistic.tol > 0.0
    println matrix.ShapeString(logistic.coef), matrix.ShapeString(logistic.intercept)
    show("prediction", logistic.predict(hours))
    mut proba := logistic.predict_proba(build(2, 1, "1 6"))
    println proba.at(0, 1) < 0.5, proba.at(1, 1) > 0.5, f3(logistic.score(hours, passed))
    linear.free()
    ridge.free()
    lasso.free()
    elastic.free()
    logistic.free()
end
```

Output:

```text
true true true 1.000
coefficients [2.000; 1.000]
prediction [3.000; 6.000; 7.000; 10.000; 11.000]
1.000 1.000
0.300 0.400 0.548
0.500 0.068 0.968
true true 1 true 1.727
ridge [1.818; 0.545]
true 5x1
true true 0.1 1 true 1000 true true true
lasso [1.950; 0.583]
true 5x1
true 0.5
true true 2 true true true
1x2 1x2
prediction [0.000; 0.000; 0.000; 1.000; 1.000; 1.000]
true true 1.000
```

### `DecisionTree`

```salam
struct DecisionTree
```

A decision tree for classification or regression.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `criterion` | `int` | The split criterion, one of the `TREE_...` constants. |
| `max_depth` | `int = 16` | The maximum tree depth. |
| `min_samples_split` | `int = 2` | The minimum number of samples needed to split a node. |
| `min_samples_leaf` | `int = 1` | The minimum number of samples in a leaf. |
| `max_features` | `int = 0` | How many features each split tries; zero means all of them. |
| `seed` | `i64 = 42` | The random seed, for a repeatable result. |
| `n_classes_hint` | `int = 0` | The number of classes, if it is known in advance. |
| `feature` | `Vector` | The split feature of each node. |
| `threshold` | `Vector` | The split threshold of each node. |
| `left` | `Vector` | The left child of each node. |
| `right` | `Vector` | The right child of each node. |
| `value` | `matrix.Matrix` | The value or probabilities of the leaves. |
| `n_classes` | `int = 0` | The number of classes. |
| `ok` | `bool = false` | Whether the fit succeeded. |

#### `node_count`

```salam
func node_count(): int
```

# opencv

https://salamlang.github.io/Salam/std/opencv/

Computer vision with OpenCV: image processing, features, face detection, neural networks and video.

This package binds the OpenCV library and gives most of the everyday computer vision work: color conversion, resizing, filters, edge detection and thresholds, contours, ORB and SIFT features, face detection with a cascade classifier, running DNN networks, and reading and writing video and camera frames.

It needs OpenCV and the Salam shim at run time; check with `Available` that the library was loaded. For simpler work with no dependency, see the image package. The examples on the site are only type-checked.

## Types

### `VideoCapture`

```salam
struct VideoCapture
```

Reads video or a camera.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `handle` | `void*` | The internal handle. |

opencv-Detect.salam

```salam
import opencv
import image

func main:
    mut cascade := opencv.LoadCascade("haarcascade_frontalface_default.xml")
    mut photo := opencv.Read("people_en.jpg")
    if cascade.ok():
        each face in cascade.detect(photo.to_gray(), 1.1, 5, 100):
            photo.rectangle(face.x, face.y, face.width, face.height, opencv.Green(), 2)
        end
    end
    cascade.free()

    mut net := opencv.LoadNet("MobileNetSSD_en.caffemodel", "MobileNetSSD_en.prototxt")
    mut single := opencv.LoadNetSingleFile("model_en.onnx")
    if net.ok():
        _ := net.set_input(photo, 0.007843, opencv.RGB(127, 127, 127), false, opencv.Size { width = 300, height = 300 })
        output := net.forward()
        _ := net.forward_layer("detection_out")
        each obj in opencv.ParseSSDDetections(output, photo.width(), photo.height(), 0.5):
            println obj.class_id, obj.confidence, obj.x, obj.y, obj.width, obj.height
        end
    end
    net.free()
    single.free()

    mut video := opencv.OpenVideo("clip_en.mp4")
    mut camera := opencv.OpenCamera(0)
    mut writer := opencv.NewVideoWriter("out_en.mp4", "mp4v", video.fps(), 640, 480)
    println video.ok(), video.frame_count(), camera.ok(), writer.ok()
    opencv.CreateTrackbar("threshold", "preview", 100, 255)
    until video.ok():
        frame := video.read()
        if frame.empty():
            break
        end
        level := opencv.GetTrackbarPos("threshold", "preview")
        edges := frame.to_gray().canny(level as f64, 200.0)
        _ := writer.write(frame)
        opencv.Imshow("preview", edges)
        if opencv.WaitKey(1) == 27:
            break
        end
    end
    opencv.SetTrackbarPos("threshold", "preview", 50)
    opencv.DestroyWindow("preview")
    opencv.DestroyAllWindows()
    video.close()
    camera.close()
    writer.close()

    picture := opencv.ToImage(photo)
    println picture.width
    _ := opencv.FromImage(image.New(8, 8))
end
```

opencv-Features.salam

```salam
import opencv

func main:
    mut scene := opencv.Read("scene_en.jpg")
    mut target := opencv.Read("object_en.jpg")
    mut contours := scene.to_gray().threshold_otsu(255.0).find_contours()
    println contours.ok(), contours.count()
    repeat contours.count() in i:
        box := contours.bounding_rect(i)
        println contours.area(i), contours.point_count(i), contours.point(i, 0).x, box.x, box.y, box.width, box.height
        scene.draw_contour(contours, i, opencv.Green(), 2)
    end
    contours.free()

    corners := scene.to_gray().good_features(50, 0.01, 10.0)
    println corners.len()
    mut keys1 := scene.detect_orb(500)
    mut keys2 := target.detect_orb(500)
    mut sift := scene.detect_sift(500)
    println keys1.ok(), keys1.count(), sift.count()
    if keys1.count() > 0:
        first := keys1.get(0)
        println first.x, first.y, first.size, first.angle, first.response
    end
    matches := opencv.MatchDescriptors(keys1.descriptors(), keys2.descriptors(), 50, opencv.NORM_HAMMING)
    each m in matches:
        println m.query_idx, m.train_idx, m.distance
    end
    println opencv.NORM_L2
    keys1.free()
    keys2.free()
    sift.free()

    found := scene.find_template(target)
    println found.found, found.x, found.y, found.score
    mut quad := Vector {} as Vector<opencv.Point>
    quad.push(opencv.Point { x = 0, y = 0 })
    quad.push(opencv.Point { x = 400, y = 10 })
    quad.push(opencv.Point { x = 410, y = 580 })
    quad.push(opencv.Point { x = 5, y = 590 })
    flat := scene.warp_perspective(quad, 420, 594)
    _ := opencv.Write("document_en.png", flat)
end
```

opencv-Basics.salam

```salam
import opencv

func main:
    if not opencv.Available():
        println "OpenCV is not available:", opencv.LastError()
        ret
    end
    println opencv.Version()
    mut photo := opencv.Read("photo_en.jpg")
    if not photo.ok() or photo.empty():
        photo = opencv.NewBlank(320, 240, 3, opencv.White())
    end
    dims := photo.size()
    println photo.width(), photo.height(), photo.channels(), dims.width, dims.height, photo.step(), photo.total(), photo.data() != null
    color := photo.at(10, 10)
    println color.r, color.g, color.b
    photo.set_pixel(0, 0, opencv.RGB(255, 128, 0))
    black := opencv.Zeros(10, 10, 1)
    println black.channels(), opencv.Black().r, opencv.Red().r, opencv.Green().g, opencv.Blue().b

    gray := photo.to_gray()
    _ := photo.to_rgb()
    hsv := photo.to_hsv()
    _ := hsv.hsv_to_rgb()
    _ := photo.convert_color(opencv.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
    _ := gray.convert_color(opencv.COLOR_GRAY2BGR)
    println opencv.COLOR_RGB2GRAY, opencv.COLOR_GRAY2RGB, opencv.COLOR_BGR2RGB, opencv.COLOR_RGB2BGR, opencv.COLOR_BGR2HSV, opencv.COLOR_HSV2BGR, opencv.COLOR_RGB2HSV, opencv.COLOR_HSV2RGB

    small := photo.resize(160, 120, opencv.INTERP_AREA)
    _ := photo.resize_scale(2.0, 2.0)
    _ := photo.crop(10, 10, 100, 80)
    _ := photo.rotate90(opencv.ROTATE_90_CW)
    _ := photo.rotate(45.0, 1.0)
    _ := photo.flip(opencv.FLIP_BOTH)
    _ := photo.flip_horizontal()
    _ := photo.flip_vertical()
    println opencv.INTERP_NEAREST, opencv.INTERP_LINEAR, opencv.INTERP_CUBIC, opencv.INTERP_LANCZOS4, opencv.ROTATE_180, opencv.ROTATE_90_CCW, opencv.FLIP_VERTICAL, opencv.FLIP_HORIZONTAL
    copied := small.clone()
    println copied.save("small_en.png"), opencv.Write("gray_en.png", gray)
    copied.free()
    photo.free()
end
```

opencv-Filters.salam

```salam
import opencv

func main:
    mut photo := opencv.Read("photo_en.jpg")
    gray := photo.to_gray()
    _ := photo.blur(5)
    _ := photo.gaussian_blur(5, 1.5)
    _ := photo.median_blur(5)
    edges := gray.canny(50.0, 150.0)
    _ := gray.threshold(128.0, 255.0, opencv.THRESH_BINARY)
    _ := gray.threshold_otsu(255.0)
    _ := gray.adaptive_threshold(255.0, opencv.ADAPTIVE_GAUSSIAN, opencv.THRESH_BINARY, 11, 2.0)
    println opencv.THRESH_BINARY_INV, opencv.THRESH_TRUNC, opencv.THRESH_TOZERO, opencv.THRESH_TOZERO_INV, opencv.THRESH_OTSU, opencv.ADAPTIVE_MEAN
    println gray.histogram_gray().len()
    _ := edges.erode(3, 1)
    _ := edges.dilate(3, 2)
    _ := edges.morphology(opencv.MORPH_CLOSE, 5)
    println opencv.MORPH_OPEN, opencv.MORPH_GRADIENT, opencv.MORPH_TOPHAT, opencv.MORPH_BLACKHAT
    white := opencv.NewBlank(photo.width(), photo.height(), 3, opencv.White())
    _ := photo.blend(white, 0.7, 0.3, 0.0)
    _ := photo.bitwise(white, opencv.BITWISE_AND)
    _ := photo.bitwise(white, opencv.BITWISE_OR)
    _ := photo.bitwise(white, opencv.BITWISE_XOR)
    _ := photo.bitwise_not()
    _ := photo.abs_diff(white)
    photo.line(0, 0, 100, 100, opencv.Red(), 2)
    photo.rectangle(10, 10, 50, 30, opencv.Green(), 1)
    photo.circle(80, 80, 20, opencv.Blue(), -1)
    photo.ellipse(100, 50, 40, 20, 30.0, opencv.Black(), 2)
    photo.put_text("Salam", 10, 200, 1.0, opencv.White(), 2)
    mut points := Vector {} as Vector<opencv.Point>
    points.push(opencv.Point { x = 0, y = 0 })
    points.push(opencv.Point { x = 50, y = 0 })
    points.push(opencv.Point { x = 25, y = 40 })
    photo.polylines(points, true, opencv.Red(), 2)
    photo.fill_poly(points, opencv.Green())
    _ := opencv.Write("filtered_en.png", photo)
end
```
